/instructions.from:
SpecBoard のプロジェクトを読み書きします。ツールは <対象>_<control>（対象は project・section・card・tag・kind・branch・mr・inspection・export、
control は list・create・read・update・delete ほか）で、guide と batch だけは 1 語です。ツールは tools/list の一覧で全部で、途中で変わりません。
各ツールの value の説明に、target の指すものごとのキーがあります。

引数はどのツールでも同じ意味です:
- project: プロジェクトの名前（slug・id でも）。毎回渡します（画面で開いているものは見ません）
- target: 対象のパス（配列を取るツールでは、いくつも）
- value: 書く値や読み方。キーは一覧の value の説明に、その種類だけが取るキーは guide の about: <種類> にあります
- branch: 読み書きする木。省くか main で main、branch の名前でその branch、_project_board_ でプロジェクトボード（やることを置く木）。
  作業ディレクトリは main と各 branch の根の直下のセクション（repo/src:'a.rs' のように読む）
- request: 都度承認の項目に当たるとき、true で画面に許可を求めて答えを待ちます（2 分まで）。付けなければ断られます

パスは <セクション>/<セクション>:<カード>.<名前> で、木は書きません。根のセクションは根の名前（既定 Main）です。

  Core:User / Core:User.profile.avatar.url   カード / 入れ子の末端
  Store/Ordering:Order.lines[].sku           入れ子のセクション・配列の中（[] は省いてもよい）
  Docs:Spec.auth / Behavior:Checkout.review  formatdoc の行 / 入れ物（flow・goal）の中のカード
  repo/docs/design:'CardKinds.md'            区切りの字を含む名前（一重引用符で囲む）

名前は日本語・空白・記号も使えます。区切りの字（空白と / : . [ ] ' @ | { } # " `）を含む名前だけ、パスの中で一重引用符で囲みます（名前の中の ' は ''）。
答えのパスはいつもこのフルパスで、そのまま次に渡せます。value の中のパス（connections の to・at など）はセクションを省けば
target のカードのセクションから読み、保存のときにフルパスに直ります。本文と説明には [[パス]]（指す）・{{パス}}（値を差し込む）・
![[パス]]（図を入れる）を書け、改名・移動に付いて行きます。カードは種類の合うセクションに置きます（種類と置ける所は kind_list）。
書く前に、書く場所ごとの説明の決まりを project_read の value {as: "rules"} で読みます。

guide は about に名前 1 つか名前の配列を取ります（省くと名前の一覧）。その種類だけのキーと例は about: <種類>（entity・flow・formatdoc・goal など。
プロジェクトの種類は project も渡す）、キーや仕組みの書き方は about: connections・body・layout・rev・paging・paths・branch・board、仕様を先に書いて実装する進め方は about: sdd、
ツールの細かい決まりは、断られたときに案内される about: <ツール> で読みます。
1 回の呼び出しは 1 つのトランザクションで、1 つでも断られたら何も書かず、直し方と guide の読み先を返します。
/instructions.text:
Reads and writes SpecBoard projects. A tool is named <subject>_<control> (subject is one of project, section, card, tag, kind, branch, mr, inspection, export;
control is list, create, read, update, delete, and so on), except guide and batch, which are one word. The tools/list response has all the tools, and it does not change midway.
Each tool's value description has its keys, by what target points at.

Arguments mean the same in every tool:
- project: the name of the project (a slug or id works too). Pass it every time (the project open in the app is not looked at)
- target: the path of what to act on (several, in a tool that takes an array)
- value: the value to write, or how to read. Its keys are in the value description in the list; the keys only one kind takes are in guide, about: <kind>
- branch: the tree to read and write. Left out or main for main, the name of a branch for that branch, _project_board_ for the Project Board (the tree that holds to-dos).
  A working directory is a section directly under the root of main and every branch (read like repo/src:'a.rs')
- request: when the call hits an item that asks each time, true asks for permission in the app and waits for the answer (up to 2 minutes). Without it, the call is refused

A path is <section>/<section>:<card>.<name>, and the tree is not written. The root section has the root's name (Main by default).

  Core:User / Core:User.profile.avatar.url   a card / the end of a nested path
  Store/Ordering:Order.lines[].sku           a nested section / inside an array ([] may be left out)
  Docs:Spec.auth / Behavior:Checkout.review  a row of a formatdoc / a card inside a container (flow, goal)
  repo/docs/design:'CardKinds.md'            a name holding a separator character (wrapped in single quotes)

A name can use any language, spaces and symbols. Only a name holding a separator character (a space or / : . [ ] ' @ | { } # " `) is wrapped in single quotes in a path (a ' inside a name is written '').
Paths in answers are always full paths like these, and can be passed on as they are. A path inside value (such as to and at of connections) may leave out the section;
if so, it is read from the section of the card in target and saved as the full path. In a body and a description you can write [[path]] (points to something), {{path}} (inserts a value) and
![[path]] (inserts a diagram); they follow renames and moves. Put a card in a section that fits its kind (kind_list has the kinds and where each goes).
Before writing, read the writing rules for each place with value {as: "rules"} of project_read.

guide takes one name or an array of names in about (none lists the names). The keys only one kind takes, with an example, are in about: <kind> (entity, flow, formatdoc, goal, and so on;
for a project's own kind, pass project too), how a key or a mechanism is written in about: connections, body, layout, rev, paging, paths, branch, board, the way of writing the spec first and implementing it in about: sdd,
and a tool's finer rules in about: <tool>, which a refusal points at.
One call is one transaction: if even one part is refused, nothing is written, and the refusal says how to fix it and where to read in guide.

/glossary.from:
# 用語集

画面と MCP で同じ語を使う。語はそれを書くときのキーや値そのもの。この文書はテスト `GlossaryTests` が `sources/SpecBoard/Model/Glossary.swift` から書き出し、プロジェクトの Docs/Design:Glossary に置く。

## プロジェクトの形

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `project` | スキーマと振る舞いの設計図の全体 |
| `main` | いまの実装を表すツリー。プロジェクトに 1 つ |
| `branch` | 変更の計画。main から作り、作ったときの main の全部を見て、branch で書いたものだけが branch のものになる。作ったあとの main の変更は、main を取り込むまで映らない。main からは見えず、branch どうしも見えない |
| `section` | カードの組。main・branch とボードの根の直下はプロジェクトの project_tree で決まり（種類と名前と並び）、ほかのセクションはその中に作り、入れ子にできる。パスでは Store/Ordering:Order のように書く |
| `project_tree` | プロジェクトの木。main・branch の根の直下（main_sections）とボードの根の直下（board_sections）のセクションの種類・名前・並び。書き換えると、外したセクションは空なら消え、中身があれば _evacuation_ へ退避する |
| `free` | フリーセクション。どの種類のカードも置ける下書きの場所。種類の合うセクションへ移して整理する |
| `ui` | UI のセクション。部品（html・svg のカード）と、ほかの UI のセクションをはめ込むはめ込み（frame）を置いて画面を組む。note も置ける。中に作るセクションも ui。プロジェクトの project_tree に type: ui で足す。画面ではセクションマップで開き、部品をモックと同じ見た目で、置いた所に並び順に重ねて描く。部品の角に見出しの札（headerPlace）と付箋（notePlace）を重ね、図の上のバーの「見出し」「ノート」で出し入れする |
| `mock` | モック。UI のセクションの部品を、置いた所に置いた大きさで組み上げた 1 枚の HTML のページ（はめ込みには指す先の UI のセクションのモックが入る。note のカードは描かない。スクリプトは動かない）。MCP は section_read の as: mock（html・width・height・parts・frames）で読み、faces: true で部品ごとのページ（faces）も添え、as: picture で絵。画面のセクションマップは部品ごとのページで部品を描く。エクスポートすると UI のセクションごとに 1 枚の .html |
| `board` | プロジェクトボード。やること（目標と小目標・作業の文書）を置く、main・branch の外の木。merge・ロック・MR は無く、いつでも書ける。MCP は branch: "_project_board_"。ボードのカードからは main のカードへ「つながる」線（link）を引け、本文に main のパスを書ける（main からボードへは引けない） |
| `ghost` | カードゴースト。セクションに置く、ほかのセクションのカード（かカードゴースト）を指すショートカット（macOS のエイリアスのようなもの。コピーではない）。自分の名前を持ち、置いたセクションの中ではその名前だけで書け、ほかからは section:名前 で書ける。指す先（target）は id で覚えて改名・移動に付いて行き、本物が消えると指す先の無いカードゴーストとして残る。セクションの図には指す先のカードが丸ごと出る。カードゴーストの無いほかのセクションのカードは、セクションごとに 1 枚のセクションゴーストにまとまり、指されている所だけが出る。画面で一時的に出すだけのもの（一時カードゴースト）はプロジェクトに残らない |
| `standalone` | value・enum を自分のセクションの図に、持っているカードの中に畳まずに 1 枚のカードで出す（見かけ。コミットにならない） |
| `base` | branch で main のカードを初めて書いたときの main の中身。branch で変えたことは base と比べて言う（branch_read） |
| `merge` | branch で変えたことを main に入れること（作り直しているあいだは使えない） |
| `path` | section:Card.field の形で場所を指す書き方。書いた場所のツリーの中で探す。区切りの字（空白と / : . [ ] ' @ \| { } # " `）を含む名前は一重引用符で囲む（Docs:'release notes.md'。名前の中の ' は ''） |
| `in` | 入れ物のカード（flow・goal。種類の定義の holds に中に置ける種類がある）の中のカードが入っている入れ物。中のカードのパスは入れ物のパスに名前を続ける（Behavior:Checkout.review・Goals:Launch.Design）。card_update の in で入れ物を移す |

## カードの種類（kind）

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `entity` | 単位で保存・送信される記録（ID を持つ） |
| `value` | 何かの中に入る形（ID を持たない）。セクションマップでは持っているカードの中に畳んで出る |
| `enum` | 値の集合（open なら網羅でない）。値ごとに表示名と説明を持てる。セクションマップでは持っているカードの中に畳んで出る |
| `flow` | 部品がすることと、部品をまたぐ処理の流れ（MCP のリクエストを受ける・ユーザー登録など。部品はセクションで表す）。入れ物のカードで、中に開始・処理・実行・判断・待つ・合流・終了のノードのカードを置き、線でつなぐ |
| `store` | 記録を置く場所（テーブル・コレクション・台帳・ファイル） |
| `instance` | データ。entity・value の実例（形を持つ実際の値）。定義のセクション（definition。新しいプロジェクトでは根の Definitions）とフリーセクションに置く。形は線 of（MCP は value のキー of に形のパス）、値は data に持つ。図とエディタは形のフィールドごとに型の札と値を並べる。値 1 つのパスは Data:first.status（並びの要素は Data:first.lines[0]・Data:first.lines[sku=A-1]）。形の JSON Schema の examples と、文書の card の行の表に出る |
| `table` | 表。形（entity・value）のデータ（instance）を決まり（within・where・columns・sort・unnest）で集めた表のカード。定義・ドキュメント・フリーのセクションに置く。形は線 of（MCP は value のキー of に形のパス）。図は組み上がった表の絵で、文書には本文の埋め込みか行 card で表として入り、エクスポートでは Markdown の表 |
| `note` | カードのそばに置く付箋（メモ・変更履歴）。どの種類のセクションにも置け、本文（body）を持つ。セクションマップで本文が見える |
| `freedoc` | 自由文書。ドキュメントセクションに置く Markdown 1 枚（body）の文書。エクスポートすると 1 枚が 1 ファイル |
| `formatdoc` | 整形文書。ドキュメントセクションに置く、項目と行（rows）で組んだ設計書・仕様書。エクスポートすると 1 枚が 1 ファイル |
| `stackdoc` | 積み重ね文書。ドキュメントセクションに置く、版（versions）を新しい順に重ねた文書（変更履歴など）。図とエディタはセレクタで選んだ版を見せる。エクスポートするとカード全体が 1 ファイルで、エクスポートの項目に版のパスを書くとその版だけ |
| `svg` | SVG の絵。本文（body）に SVG を書き、図の上ではカードの箱に収めて（縦横の比を保って）画像として描く（中のスクリプトは動かず、外のものは読み込まない）。本文は XML として読め、根が svg の要素であること。ドキュメント・フリー・UI のセクションに置き、大きさを変えられる。エクスポートすると 1 枚が 1 ファイル（.svg） |
| `html` | HTML のページ。本文（body）に HTML（CSS も）を書き、図の上ではカードの箱の幅で組んで箱で切って描く。スクリプト・外の読み込み・フォームの送信は動かない（sb-nav:<パス> のリンクはアプリの中で、http・https はブラウザで開く）。ドキュメント・フリー・UI のセクションに置き、大きさを変えられる。エクスポートすると 1 枚が 1 ファイル（.html。頭に同じ守りを書く） |
| `frame` | はめ込み。UI のセクションに置き、欄 target の UI のセクションのモックを自分の箱に 1:1 ではめ込む（はみ出す所は切る）。target はパスで書き、id で覚えて改名・移動に付いて行く。自分のいるセクションと、たどると自分のいるセクションに戻るものは指せない。同じセクションを何枚ものはめ込みで使える。大きさを変えられ、既定はカード 1 枚分 |
| `goal` | 目標。status（状態）・priority（優先度）・due（期限）・workBranch（作業する branch）・MR の欄と、本文（body）を持つ入れ物のカードで、中に goal と task を置く。中の並びが task の作業の順。プロジェクトボードの goals のセクションとフリーセクションに置く |
| `task` | タスク。済みのチェック（done）と、本文（body。決めたこと・どこまで進んだか・経緯）と、つながる線（connections の line: link）を持つ。goal の中に入れると、goal の行（番号・チェック・名前）として出る。図の上では種類の定義の face のとおり、チェックと本文の Markdown で描き、大きさを変えられる |
| `file` | ファイル。作業ディレクトリ（この機械で結び付けたフォルダ）を読んで、コアが作業ディレクトリのセクションの中に作るカード。名前と表示名はファイルの名前（パスでは区切りの字を含む名前を一重引用符で囲む: repo/docs:'CardKinds.md'）、filePath は作業ディレクトリからのパス、language は名前と作業ディレクトリの parsers で決まる言語。読むだけで、main と branch のカードから実装の線（implementedBy）で指す。関数と型を拾う言語のファイルは、中の関数と型（symbol）も指せ、図ではそれを行で並べる |
| `workdir` | 作業ディレクトリのセクション。main と各 branch の根の直下に、プロジェクトの木に種類 workdir で並べたもの。中はこの機械のフォルダから読んで作る読むだけのもので、置けるのはメモだけ。設定はそのセクションの section_update（readType・exclude・description・folder）、読み直すのはアクションの「読み込む」（section_action の op: read） |
| `directory` | 作業ディレクトリのセクションの中のディレクトリ。コアが読んだフォルダから作るセクションで、ファイルが種類 file のカード。読むだけ |
| `symbol` | 関数と型。関数と型を拾う言語の作業ディレクトリのファイルの中の関数・メソッド・型・モジュール・定数・マクロで、コアが同梱の tree-sitter の文法で読むたびにファイルから作るカード（保存しない）。パスはファイルのパスに続ける（repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total。同じ親に同じ名前が並べば、あとのものに「 (2)」）。of（どの言語でも同じ分け方。画面の札は ƒ が関数とメソッド・T が型・M がモジュール・C が定数・# がマクロ）・word（その言語での呼び方: fn・struct・protocol など）・language を持つ。main と branch のカードから実装の線（implementedBy）で指せ、関数と型から線は出せない。card_read で宣言の 1 行（declaration）・中身（body）・呼んでいる名前（calls）を読む |
| `parsers` | 言語の対応。作業ディレクトリのファイルの拡張子（.h）か名前（Makefile）から、読む言語の id（cpp。null で言語なし）への対応。作業ディレクトリのセクションの section_update の parsers で既定を書き換え、parsers: null で既定に戻す。読み方（readType・exclude）と同じくプロジェクトの設定で、section_read に効いている対応と言語（languages）が出る |

## flow のノード

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `begin` | 開始。trigger と next の線。受けて始まる（receive）ときは相手のフローへの peer の線（何本でも）と program（どちらも省くと呼んだ側）・carries |
| `trigger` | 開始のきっかけ: manual（手動）・receive（受ける）・event（ほかのフローの終わり）・schedule（定期）・startup（起動のたび） |
| `process` | 処理。steps にまっすぐ続く行（読む・書く・署名・確かめる・呼ぶ・送る・受ける・計算する）と next の線。行が読む・書く所は reads・writes の線（from に行） |
| `run` | 実行。runs の線のフローを呼んで終わりを待つ（carries を渡し、returns を受ける）。onError・next の線 |
| `eval` | 判断。value と、branch の線（欄 when）・else の線 |
| `wait` | 待つ。for（approval / timer / event）・timeout と、onTimeout・next の線 |
| `join` | 合流。next の線を 2 本以上にして分かれた行き先がそろうのを待つ（join: all / any / first、partial: fail / continue） |
| `end` | 終了。outcome（success / failure / cancelled）がフローの戻り値。返すものは return |
| `diagram` | flow の図の形の既定: flowchart（コンテンツマップの図）/ sequence（シーケンス図）。エクスポート・文書の図・MCP の図はこの形で描く |
| `topLeft` | カードやノードの左上の位置（マス。{x, y}） |

## note と文書

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `body` | note と freedoc の本文（Markdown）。`[[パス]]` で欄を指し（`[[セクション:]]` でセクション、`[[パス\|字]]` で見せる字を変える）、`{{パス}}` で値（const のある欄・列挙・データの値）を差し込み、`![[パス]]` の 1 行で図を入れる |
| `rows` | formatdoc の行。name（パスに使う名前）と kind: item（項目。heading と中の rows、5 段まで）・text（本文）・table（表）・diagram（図）・diagrams（セクションの図）・card（カードの表）。パスはフィールドと同じ形（Docs:Spec.auth.login） |
| `versions` | stackdoc の版。name（パスに使う名前）・key（セレクタに出す名前）・heading（見出し。省くと key）・body（本文の Markdown）。並びは新しい版が上で、版のパスは Docs:Changelog.v0_2_21 |
| `version` | stackdoc で開いている版（版の name。見かけで、コミットにならない）。無ければ一番上の版 |

## フィールド

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `required` | キーが必ずある |
| `nullable` | null が正当な値（required とは独立） |
| `const` | 常にこの値を取る |
| `data` | データ（instance）の値。形と同じ入れ子の JSON（キーはフィールドの名前、並びの欄は配列）。書いた値は形のフィールドの型・nullable・const・列挙の値・判別子の枝と、文字の値は欄の rules の pattern で確かめ、合わなければ断る。required の欠けは書き途中として点検に出る。形から消えたフィールドの値は strayFields に残る |

## 線（connections）

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `connections` | カードの線の並び。1 本ずつ line（線の種類）・from（出る欄や行。省けば頭）・to（相手）・at（相手の中の着く所）・description・fields（線の種類が決める欄） |
| `line` | 線の種類。組み込み（embed・points・link・holds・of・notes・mentions と、flow のノードの線 next・branch・else・onError・onTimeout・runs・event・reads・writes・peer・key）とプロジェクトが定義するもの。意味（定義の base）は embed（型が相手になる）・designate（型は変わらず相手を指す）・link（型に関係しない）。kind_list・kind_read で読み、kind_create・kind_update で定義する |
| `embed` | 内包: 欄が相手の形をそのまま持つ（生成される型が変わる。欄の type は ref と読む） |
| `points` | ID で指す: 欄の値が相手の ID（型は変わらない） |
| `of` | 形: データ（instance）と表（table）から形（entity・value）への線。1 本だけで、MCP は value のキー of に形のパスを書く（connections には書かない）。図にははじめから描かず、カードの頭に形の名前が出る |
| `at` | 線が相手の中で着く所（欄か行。相手の外なら、そこのフルパス） |
| `fromBoard` | 関わるやること。main（と branch）のカードを線か本文のパスで指している、ボードのカードのうち済んでいないもの（済んだ task、完了・打ち切りの goal とその中のカードは出さない）。プロパティパネルと card_read に出る |

## 処理ノードの行（steps）

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `receive` | 受ける（相手のフローへの peer の線は何本でも引け、program と一緒にも書ける。どちらも省くと、呼んだ側から） |
| `return` | 終了ノードが返すもの（carries。返す相手は peer の線（何本でも）と program で、どちらも省くと呼んだ側へ） |
| `call` | プロジェクトに無い道具（program）を呼んで返りを待つ（carries を送り、returns を受ける）。プロジェクトの flow を呼んで待つのは実行ノード |
| `send` | 渡す（返りを待たない。ほかの flow を始めさせるのも）。相手は peer の線（何本でも。相手ごとに渡す）か program で、どちらかが要る |
| `read` | 置き場所から読む（reads の線） |
| `write` | 置き場所へ書く（writes の線） |
| `sign` | 署名する（key の線、use: sign） |
| `verify` | 署名を確かめる（key の線、use: verify） |
| `compute` | 計算。業務の検証や計算のような、外に出ない処理（何をするかは行の description。ほかの欄・線は持たない） |
| `via` | 受け渡しの方法: stdio / file / exec / http / grpc / websocket / queue と、プロジェクトが足した値（kind_update の flow の vias。省くと部品の中） |
| `initiator` | 呼びに行く側: self / peer（データの向きとは別） |

## セクションマップの線（凡例）

線の種類の名前と、画面の名前（定義の label）。凡例は線の種類の定義（label・説明・look）から出す。

| 語 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| `embed` | 内包: 欄が相手の形をそのまま持つ（欄の型が相手になる） |
| `points` | ID で指す: 欄の値が相手の ID（型は変わらない） |
| `link` | つながる: 型に関係しない、つながりだけの線（task からほかの task へ、など。ボードのカードから main のカードへも） |
| `holds` | 置く: store が置く記録の形 |
| `of` | 形: データ（instance）の形と、表（table）が集めるデータの形（entity・value）。はじめは描かない（カードの頭に形の名前が出る） |
| `notes` | 決まり: flow の決まりを書いた note・freedoc・formatdoc か、formatdoc の項目 |
| `implementedBy` | 実装: 仕様・設計のカードから、それを実装している作業ディレクトリのファイルか、その中の関数と型へ（main と branch から。相手は木の中のパス repo/src:'a.rs'・repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total） |
| `mentions` | 言及: note と文書の本文の `[[ ]]` が指す所（本文から拾う） |
| `next` | 次: flow のノードの次の行き先（2 本以上で並列に分かれる） |
| `branch` | 条件: 判断（eval）の分かれ道。条件（欄 when）が当たるときの行き先 |
| `else` | それ以外: 判断（eval）のどの条件にも当たらないときの行き先 |
| `onError` | 失敗したら: 実行（run）が失敗したときの行き先 |
| `onTimeout` | 期限切れ: 待つ（wait）が期限を過ぎたときの行き先 |
| `runs` | 実行する: 実行（run）が呼んで終わりを待つフロー |
| `event` | 待つ終わり: 開始・待つが待つ、ほかのフローの終わり（欄 outcome にその結果） |
| `reads` | 読む: 処理の行（read）が読む所 |
| `writes` | 書く: 処理の行（write）が書く所 |
| `peer` | 相手: 送る・受ける・返す相手のフロー（1 つの所から何本でも。同じフローへは 1 本） |
| `key` | 鍵を使う: 署名する（use: sign）・確かめる（use: verify）鍵 |
| `digest`・`signedBy`・`verifiedBy` | プロジェクトの線（前の形のプロジェクトを移したときに作る）: ハッシュで指す・署名を作る鍵・署名を確かめる鍵 |
/glossary.text:
# Glossary

The app and MCP use the same words. A term is the very key or value you write for it. This document is written out by the test `GlossaryTests` from `sources/SpecBoard/Model/Glossary.swift` and placed in the project at Docs/Design:Glossary.

## The shape of a project

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` | The whole design of the schemas and behavior |
| `main` | The tree that represents the current implementation. There is one per project |
| `branch` | A plan for changes. It is made from main, sees all of main as it was when the branch was made, and only what is written in the branch belongs to the branch. Changes made to main afterward do not show up until main is merged in. It cannot be seen from main, and branches cannot see each other |
| `section` | A group of cards. The sections directly under the root of main, branches and the board are decided by the project's project_tree (kind, name and order); other sections are created inside them and can be nested. In a path it is written like Store/Ordering:Order |
| `project_tree` | The project's tree. The kinds, names and order of the sections directly under the root of main and branches (main_sections) and directly under the root of the board (board_sections). When you rewrite it, a section taken out is removed if it is empty, and if it has contents they are set aside in _evacuation_ |
| `free` | A free section. A scratch place that takes cards of any kind. Tidy up by moving cards to a section that fits their kind |
| `ui` | A UI section. Lay out a screen with parts (html and svg cards) and frames (frame) that put other UI sections in. Notes can go here too. Sections made inside it are ui too. Added to a project with type: ui in its project_tree. In the app it opens on its section map, which draws the parts as the mock does, where they are placed and stacked in the section's order. A tag (headerPlace) and a sticky note (notePlace) are laid over each part's corners, shown or hidden with "Headers" and "Notes" on the diagram's top bar |
| `mock` | A mock. One HTML page built from a UI section's parts, each where it is placed and as big as it is placed (a frame holds the mock of the UI section it points at; note cards are not drawn; scripts do not run). In MCP, read it with section_read as: mock (html, width, height, parts, frames), with each part's own page (faces) added by faces: true, and as a picture with as: picture. The app's section map draws the parts from their own pages. When exported, each UI section is one .html |
| `board` | The Project Board. A tree outside main and the branches that holds to-dos (goals and sub-goals, and working documents). It has no merge, lock or MR, and can be written at any time. In MCP it is branch: "_project_board_". A card on the board can draw a Linked line (link) to a card in main and can write main paths in its body (a line cannot be drawn from main to the board) |
| `ghost` | A card ghost. A shortcut placed in a section that points at a card in another section (or at a card ghost) (like an alias in macOS; not a copy). It has its own name; inside the section where it is placed it can be written by that name alone, and from elsewhere as section:name. What it points at (target) is remembered by id and follows renames and moves; if the real card is deleted, it remains as a card ghost pointing at nothing. The section's diagram shows the card it points at in full. Cards in other sections that have no card ghost are gathered into one section ghost per section, and only the parts that are pointed at appear. Something shown only temporarily in the app (a temporary card ghost) does not remain in the project |
| `standalone` | Shows a value or enum as a card of its own in the diagram of its section, without folding it into the card that holds it (appearance only; it makes no commit) |
| `base` | The contents of main at the time a card of main was first written in a branch. What a branch changed is stated by comparing against base (branch_read) |
| `merge` | Putting what was changed in a branch into main (not available while it is being rebuilt) |
| `path` | A way of pointing at a place in the form section:Card.field. It is looked up in the tree where it was written. A name holding a separator character (a space or / : . [ ] ' @ \| { } # " `) is wrapped in single quotes (Docs:'release notes.md'; a ' inside a name is written '') |
| `in` | The container that a card inside a container card (flow, goal; the holds of the kind definition lists the kinds that can be put inside) is in. The path of an inner card is the container's path followed by its name (Behavior:Checkout.review, Goals:Launch.Design). Move a card to another container with in of card_update |

## Card kinds (kind)

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `entity` | A record that is saved and sent as a unit (it has an ID) |
| `value` | A shape that goes inside something (it has no ID). In the Section map it is shown folded into the card that holds it |
| `enum` | A set of values (if open, it is not exhaustive). Each value may have a display name and a description. In the Section map it is shown folded into the card that holds it |
| `flow` | What a component does, and the flow of processing across components (receiving an MCP request, user registration, and so on; components are represented by sections). It is a container card; node cards of the kinds begin, process, run, eval, wait, join and end are placed inside it and connected by lines |
| `store` | A place where records are kept (a table, collection, ledger, or file) |
| `instance` | Data. An example (instance) of an entity or value (an actual value with a shape). It is placed in a Definition section (definition; Definitions at a new project's root) or a free section. The shape is the of line (in MCP, the shape's path in the value key of), and the values are held in data. The diagram and the editor line up a type tag and a value for each field of the shape. The path of one value is Data:first.status (elements of an array are Data:first.lines[0] and Data:first.lines[sku=A-1]). It appears in examples of the shape's JSON Schema and in the table of a card row of a document |
| `table` | A table. A table card that gathers the data (instance) of a shape (entity or value) by rules (within, where, columns, sort, unnest). It is placed in Definition, Document and Free sections. The shape is the of line (in MCP, the shape's path in the value key of). The diagram is a picture of the assembled table; in a document it goes in as a table through an embed in the body or a card row, and in an export it is a Markdown table |
| `note` | A sticky note placed beside cards (memos, change history). It can be placed in a section of any kind and has a body (body). The body is visible in the Section map |
| `freedoc` | A free document. A document of one Markdown page (body) placed in a Document section. When exported, one document becomes one file |
| `formatdoc` | A formatted document. A design or specification document built from items and rows (rows), placed in a Document section. When exported, one document becomes one file |
| `stackdoc` | A stacked document. A document placed in a Document section in which versions (versions) are stacked from newest to oldest (such as a change history). The diagram and the editor show the version chosen with the selector. When exported, the whole card is one file; if you write a version's path in an item of the export, only that version is exported |
| `svg` | An SVG picture. Its body (body) is SVG; on a diagram the card draws it as an image fitted in its box (keeping its proportions), so scripts in it do not run and nothing outside is loaded. The body must read as XML with an svg root element. Placed in document, free and UI sections, and can be resized. When exported, one card is one file (.svg) |
| `html` | An HTML page. Its body (body) is HTML (CSS too); on a diagram the card draws it laid out at its box's width and cut at the box. Scripts, loading from outside and form submission do not work (sb-nav:<path> links open in the app, http and https in the browser). Placed in document, free and UI sections, and can be resized. When exported, one card is one file (.html, with the same protection at its head) |
| `frame` | A frame. Placed in a UI section, it puts the mock of the UI section in its field target into its own box at full size (what overflows is cut). target is written as a path, kept by id, and follows renames and moves. It cannot point at the section it is in, nor at one that leads back to it. The same section can be used by many frames. It can be resized; by default it is one card in size |
| `goal` | A goal. A container card that has the fields status (the state), priority, due (the due date), workBranch (the branch to work in) and MR, and a body (body); goals and tasks are placed inside it. The inner order is the order of work for tasks. It is placed in a goals section or a free section of the Project Board |
| `task` | A task. It has a done check (done), a body (body: what was decided, how far it has gone, and the background), and Linked lines (line: link in connections). When put inside a goal, it appears as a row of the goal (number, check, name). On a diagram it is drawn as the face of the kind definition says, with the check and the Markdown of the body, and its size can be changed |
| `file` | A file. A card that the core creates inside a working directory's section by reading the working directory (the folder bound on this machine). Its name and display name are the file's name (in a path, a name holding a separator character is wrapped in single quotes: repo/docs:'CardKinds.md'), and filePath is the path from the working directory, and language is the language its name and the working directory's parsers decide. It is read only, and cards in main and branches point at it with the implementedBy line. In a file of a language whose functions and types are read, those (symbol) can be pointed at too, and the map lists them as its rows |
| `workdir` | A working directory's section: directly under the root of main and every branch, listed in the project tree with the kind workdir. What is in it is read from this machine's folder and read only; only notes can be put in it. Its settings are section_update on it (readType, exclude, description, folder), and it is read again with its action Read (section_action's op: read) |
| `directory` | A directory inside a working directory's section: a section the core makes from the folder it read, with the files cards of the kind file. Read only |
| `symbol` | Functions and types. A function, method, type, module, constant or macro inside a working directory's file of a language whose functions and types are read: a card the core makes from the file each time it reads it, with the bundled tree-sitter grammars (never kept). Its path goes on from the file's (repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total; when one parent has the same name twice, the later ones get " (2)"). It has of (the same kinds in every language; the app marks them ƒ for a function or method, T a type, M a module, C a constant, # a macro), word (what its language calls it: fn, struct, protocol and so on) and language. Cards in main and branches point at it with the implementedBy line, and no line leaves it. card_read reads its declaration line (declaration), its body (body) and the names it calls (calls) |
| `parsers` | Which language each file is read in: from a working directory's file's extension (.h) or name (Makefile) to a language id (cpp; null for none). section_update of the working directory's section changes the defaults with parsers, and parsers: null puts them back. Like readType and exclude it is a project setting, and section_read says the map in force and the languages |

## Nodes of a flow

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `begin` | Start. It has trigger and the next line. When it begins by receiving (receive), it takes peer lines to the partner flows (any number) and program (if both are left out, the caller), and carries |
| `trigger` | What starts a flow: manual (by hand), receive (on receiving), event (the end of another flow), schedule (periodic), startup (at every start-up) |
| `process` | A process. Rows that follow one after another in steps (read, write, sign, verify, call, send, receive, compute) and the next line. Where a row reads or writes is given by the reads and writes lines (with the row in from) |
| `run` | A run. It calls the flow on the runs line and waits for it to end (it passes carries and receives returns). The onError and next lines |
| `eval` | A decision. value, the branch lines (with the field when) and the else line |
| `wait` | A wait. for (approval / timer / event), timeout, and the onTimeout and next lines |
| `join` | A join. With two or more next lines, it waits until the destinations that split up have all arrived (join: all / any / first, partial: fail / continue) |
| `end` | An end. outcome (success / failure / cancelled) is the return value of the flow. What it returns is return |
| `diagram` | The default form of a flow's diagram: flowchart (the diagram on the contents map) / sequence (the sequence diagram). Exports, diagrams in documents and MCP diagrams are drawn in this form |
| `topLeft` | The top-left position of a card or node (in grid cells; {x, y}) |

## Notes and documents

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `body` | The body of a note and a freedoc (Markdown). `[[path]]` points at a field (`[[section:]]` at a section, `[[path\|text]]` shows other words), `{{path}}` inserts a value (a field with const, an enumeration, or a value in data), and a line of `![[path]]` puts in a diagram |
| `rows` | The rows of a formatdoc. name (a name used in the path) and kind: item (an item: a heading and the rows inside it, up to 5 levels), text (a body), table (a table), diagram (a diagram), diagrams (the section's diagrams), card (a table of cards). The path has the same form as a field's (Docs:Spec.auth.login) |
| `versions` | The versions of a stackdoc. name (a name used in the path), key (the name shown in the selector), heading (the heading; key if left out), body (the Markdown body). The newest version comes first, and a version's path is Docs:Changelog.v0_2_21 |
| `version` | The version open in a stackdoc (the name of a version; appearance only, it makes no commit). If there is none, the top version |

## Fields

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `required` | The key is always present |
| `nullable` | null is a valid value (independent of required) |
| `const` | Always takes this value |
| `data` | The values of data (instance). JSON nested in the same way as the shape (keys are field names; array fields are arrays). The values written are checked against the type, nullable, const, enumeration values and discriminator branches of the shape's fields, and string values against the pattern of the field's rules, and refused if they do not match. A missing required shows up in the inspection as still being written. The values of fields removed from the shape remain in strayFields |

## Lines (connections)

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `connections` | The list of a card's lines. Each line has line (the kind of line), from (the field or row it leaves from; the head if left out), to (the partner), at (where it lands inside the partner), description, and fields (fields decided by the kind of line) |
| `line` | The kind of a line. Built-in ones (embed, points, link, holds, of, notes, mentions, and the lines of flow nodes: next, branch, else, onError, onTimeout, runs, event, reads, writes, peer, key) and ones the project defines. The meaning (base of the definition) is embed (the type becomes the partner), designate (the type does not change and the partner is pointed at), or link (unrelated to the type). Read them with kind_list and kind_read, and define them with kind_create and kind_update |
| `embed` | Embeds: the field holds the partner's shape as it is (the generated type changes; the type of the field reads as ref) |
| `points` | Points by ID: the value of the field is the partner's ID (the type does not change) |
| `of` | Shape: the line from data (instance) and a table (table) to a shape (entity, value). Only one is allowed, and in MCP the shape's path is written in the value key of (not in connections). It is not drawn on the diagram at first; the shape's name appears at the head of the card |
| `at` | Where a line lands inside the partner (a field or a row; if outside the partner, its full path) |
| `fromBoard` | Related to-dos. Those board cards that point at a card in main (and branches) by a line or a path in the body and are not finished (done tasks, goals whose status is 完了 or 打ち切り (done or cancelled), and the cards inside them are not shown). It appears in the Properties panel and in card_read |

## Rows of a process node (steps)

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `receive` | Receive (any number of peer lines to partner flows can be drawn, and they can be written together with program. If both are left out, it is received from the caller) |
| `return` | What an end node returns (carries. The partners it returns to are given by peer lines (any number) and program; if both are left out, it returns to the caller) |
| `call` | Calls a tool outside the project (program) and waits for the reply (sends carries and receives returns). Calling and waiting for a flow of the project is done by a run node |
| `send` | Hands over (does not wait for a reply; this includes having another flow started). The partner is given by peer lines (any number; it is handed over to each partner) or program, and one of them is required |
| `read` | Reads from a store (the reads line) |
| `write` | Writes to a store (the writes line) |
| `sign` | Signs (the key line, use: sign) |
| `verify` | Verifies a signature (the key line, use: verify) |
| `compute` | Computation. Processing that does not go outside, such as business validation or calculation (what it does is in the row's description; it has no other fields or lines) |
| `via` | The method of exchange: stdio / file / exec / http / grpc / websocket / queue, and values the project has added (vias of flow in kind_update; if left out, it is inside the component) |
| `initiator` | The side that makes the call: self / peer (separate from the direction of the data) |

## Lines in the Section map (legend)

The names of the line kinds and their names in the app (label in the definition). The legend is produced from the line kind definitions (label, description, look).

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `embed` | Embeds: the field holds the partner's shape as it is (the type of the field becomes the partner) |
| `points` | Points by ID: the value of the field is the partner's ID (the type does not change) |
| `link` | Linked: a line that only connects and has nothing to do with types (from a task to another task, for example; also from a board card to a card in main) |
| `holds` | Holds: the shape of the records a store holds |
| `of` | Shape: the shape of data (instance), and the shape (entity, value) of the data a table gathers. Not drawn at first (the shape's name appears at the head of the card) |
| `notes` | Rules: a note, freedoc or formatdoc that writes the rules of a flow, or an item of a formatdoc |
| `implementedBy` | Implemented by: from a spec or design card to the file in the working directory that implements it, or to a function or type in it (from main and branches. The partner is its path in the tree, repo/src:'a.rs' or repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total) |
| `mentions` | Mentions: what `[[ ]]` in the body of a note and a document points at (picked up from the body) |
| `next` | Next: the next destination of a flow node (with two or more, it splits in parallel) |
| `branch` | Condition: a fork of a decision (eval). The destination when the condition (field when) holds |
| `else` | Otherwise: the destination when none of the conditions of a decision (eval) holds |
| `onError` | On failure: the destination when a run fails |
| `onTimeout` | On timeout: the destination when a wait passes its time limit |
| `runs` | Runs: the flow that a run calls and waits for |
| `event` | Awaited end: the end of another flow that a begin or wait waits for (the field outcome holds the result) |
| `reads` | Reads: where a row (read) of a process reads |
| `writes` | Writes: where a row (write) of a process writes |
| `peer` | Partner: the flow to send to, receive from, or return to (any number from one place; only one to the same flow) |
| `key` | Uses key: the key that signs (use: sign) or verifies (use: verify) |
| `digest`, `signedBy`, `verifiedBy` | Lines defined in the project (created when a project in the former format was migrated): points by hash, the key that makes a signature, the key that verifies a signature |

/branchGuide.from:
# branch

プロジェクトはリモートの無い git のリポジトリのように扱います。main がいまの実装、branch は main から作る変更の計画です。
パスに branch は書きません（Core:User は、どの branch でも同じカードを指します）。

## 名指し方

- section_*・card_*・tag_list・tag_update・export_read・inspection_* は、引数 branch で木を名指します: 省くか main で main、
  branch の名前でその branch、_project_board_ でプロジェクトボード（やることを置く、merge しない木）。作業ディレクトリは main と各 branch のセクション
- 答えの頭に、どの branch のものかを 1 度出します。画面で開いている branch には縛られません（替えるのは app_control の op: select）
- プロジェクトに 1 つのもの（設定・タググループ・種類の定義・書き方の決まり・作業ディレクトリ・書き出し）は、どの branch にもすぐ効き、
  project_read・project_update に branch を付けると断ります。export_execute は branch も書けます（targetdir に書く先のパス。[default] は main だけ）
- batch は、開くときに branch を 1 度名指します
- branch そのもの: branch_list・branch_read（as: diff と against か path（前と後の中身）・diagram・history）・
  branch_create（main からだけ）・branch_update（改名）・branch_delete（discard: true で merge していない変更ごと）・branch_merge・branch_revert。
  MR は mr_list・mr_read・mr_delete

## merge

- branch_merge の target が merge 元（main も可）、value の into が merge 先（省けば main）。main を取り込むのは target に main、into に branch
- カードの欄・フィールド・列挙の値・版・formatdoc の行ごとに、共通の基点・merge 元・merge 先の 3 つで比べ、片側だけが変えた所はそちらを取ります。
  両側が変えた所（片方が消して片方が直したものも）は衝突で、take で選びます。branch_read の against で下見でき、
  その conflicts の path と unit をそのまま take に写せます
- main へ入れると merge 元の branch は退けます（keep: true で残す）。位置は、merge 先に無いものにだけ入ります（places: true で全部）

## 履歴と戻す

- 画面の 1 操作・MCP の 1 回の呼び出し（batch の実行は全体で 1 回）が、branch ごとに 1 コミットで、書き手と変える前の中身が残ります
- branch_read の as: history で新しい順に読み、branch_revert の to に seq を書くと、そのコミットのすぐあとの形に「戻す」の
  1 コミットで戻します（ほかの書き手のコミットを挟むと断る）。main を戻すと、main は書き換えずに戻した形の branch を作るので、それを merge します
- as: history に seq を足すとそのコミットの中身を読め、branch_revert の undo でそのコミットだけを取り消します（ほかの書き手のは request: true で）

## ロックと MR

- main がロック中（project_read の locked: true）は、main は merge でしか変わりません。branch を名指して書きます。ロック中も main に書けるのは
  見かけ（位置と並び（topLeft・position・places）・size・view・standalone）・タグ・プロジェクトの設定です
- ロック中の main へ branch_merge すると、merge をその場で試した MR（title・description）を出します。人が画面で承認するので、ユーザーに伝えます。
  拒否されたら mr_read の reason を読んで直し、出し直します。branch か入るものが動くと MR は stale（古い）になり、出し直します。
  project_read の aiMerge: true なら、MR を出さずにそのまま入ります
- batch が押さえている branch は画面から直せず、画面で「まとめて直す」をしている branch へは MCP から書けません

## git と違う所

- branch は作ったときの main を見て、そのあとの main の変更は main を取り込むまで映りません（遅れは branch_list・branch_read に出る）。
  リモート・rebase はありません（main を取り込む）
- branch で書いたカードだけが branch の写しになり、id は main と同じです
/branchGuide.text:
# branch

A project is treated like a git repository with no remote: main is the current implementation, and a branch is a plan for changes made from main.
Paths never include a branch: Core:User is the same card on every branch.

## Naming a branch

- section_*, card_*, tag_list, tag_update, export_read and inspection_* name the tree with the argument branch: left out or main for main,
  a branch's name for that branch, _project_board_ for the Project Board (the tree of to-dos, never merged). A working directory is a section of main and every branch
- The answer names its branch once, at the top. The branch open in the app does not matter (app_control op: select changes it)
- What a project has once (settings, tag groups, kind definitions, writing rules, working directory, exports) takes effect on every branch at once,
  and project_read and project_update refuse a branch. export_execute writes a branch too (targetdir a folder path; [default] is main's alone)
- batch names the branch once, when opened
- The branches themselves: branch_list, branch_read (as: diff with against, or path for the before and after; diagram; history),
  branch_create (from main only), branch_update (rename), branch_delete (discard: true with changes not merged), branch_merge, branch_revert.
  MRs: mr_list, mr_read, mr_delete

## merge

- In branch_merge, target is the merge source (main too) and into in value is the merge target (main if left out). To bring main in, put main in target and the branch in into
- Each card field, entity or value field, enum value, version and formatdoc row is compared three ways, and where only one side changed it, that side is taken.
  Where both sides changed it (or one deleted it and the other edited it), it is a conflict, chosen with take. Preview with against of branch_read,
  and copy the path and unit of its conflicts into take
- Into main, the merge source branch is set aside (keep: true keeps it). Positions go in only where the merge target has none (places: true brings them all)

## History and revert

- One action in the app or one MCP call (a batch run counts as one) is one commit per branch, with the writer and the contents before
- as: history of branch_read reads them newest first, and to: <seq> of branch_revert returns the tree to right after that commit as one Revert
  commit (refused across other writers' commits). Reverting main makes a branch with the reverted shape instead of rewriting main; merge that branch
- seq in as: history reads what that commit changed; undo of branch_revert undoes that commit alone (another writer's with request: true)

## Lock and MR

- While main is locked (locked: true in project_read), main changes only by merge: name a branch and write there. What still writes to a locked main is
  appearance (places and order: topLeft, position, places; size, view, standalone), tags and the project settings
- branch_merge into a locked main opens an MR (title, description) with the merge tried on the spot. A person approves it in the app, so tell the user.
  If rejected, read reason of mr_read, fix and merge again; if the branch or what goes in moves, the MR goes stale: send it again.
  With aiMerge: true in project_read it goes in directly, with no MR
- The app cannot edit a branch a batch holds, and MCP cannot write a branch the app is batch-editing

## Differences from git

- A branch sees main as it was when made; later changes to main show only after merging main in (branch_list and branch_read show how far behind).
  There is no remote or rebase (merge main in instead)
- Only the cards written on a branch become its copies, with the same id as in main

/boardGuide.from:
goal と task は、プロジェクトボード（branch: "_project_board_"）の goals のセクションとフリーセクションに置くカードです。欄は種類のキー（guide の about: goal・task）で、欄の名前（英語のキー。画面は label の名前）で書きます。個人向けの道具なので、担当の欄はありません。
- goal は入れ物で、中に goal と task を置きます。中のパスは <goal のパス>.<名前>（Goals/Refunds:Launch.Design）で、名前は goal の中で一意。task の中に task は入れず、入れ子は goal で、細かい確かめは task の本文の Markdown のチェックリスト（- [ ]）で書きます
- goal の中に作るのは card_create の target を <goal のパス>.<名前> に、ほかの goal へ移すのは card_update の in（goal のパス。in: null で goal の外のセクションへ）。task の作業の順は goal の中の並び（position。0 から。画面は 1・2・3…）、目標の予定の順は goal の表示名の頭の番号（1. 2. …）
- priority は 高・中・低（書かなければ決めていない）。status は状態（完了 で済み）、workBranch は作業する branch、MR は MR の番号
- 線は connections の line: link で、to に仕様のカード・note・freedoc・goal・task のパス（ボードのカードは main のカードをフルパスで指せる）
- 読む: card_read の goal は中のカードのパス（cards）。外した欄に残る値は strayFields で返し、card_update の strayFields（null で全部）で消します。card_list の kind（goal・task）・fields（{"status": "進行中"}・{"done": false}。値を並びにするとそのどれか）・in（goal のパス）で issue の一覧のように絞れ、goal は番号の順に progress（済み done と全部 of）を添えて並びます
- 材料を読む: card_read の value {as: "context"} に goal か task を渡すと、指している仕様の行・形・実装の関数の本文を、goal の workBranch の branch で解いて 1 回で返す（進め方は about: sdd）
- goal を開くと中のカードのコンテンツマップ。task は済みのチェックと本文の Markdown で描き、card_update の size で大きさを変えます（見かけ。null で本文に合わせる）。箱は card_read の include: ["places"] で読み、card_update の places（{"Goals:Refunds.Design": {"topLeft": {"x": 0, "y": 0}}}）でまとめて置きます
- 前の形（goal の items・card_create の in・日本語のキー 状態・優先度・期限・PR・担当）は、今の書き方を添えて断ります
- 始める・終える・打ち切る・済みにするは card_action（op: start・finish・cancel・done）で、branch と欄と置き場を 1 回で書きます。終えた goal は Goals の中の完了のセクション（種類 complete）へ、打ち切った goal は打ち切りのセクション（cancelled）へ移ります
/boardGuide.text:
goal and task cards go in a goals section or a free section of the Project Board (branch: "_project_board_"). Their fields are the kind's keys (guide, about: goal, task), written by the field name (the English key; the app shows the label). Since this is a tool for personal use, there is no assignee field.
- A goal is a container: goals and tasks go inside it. The path of an inner card is <goal path>.<name> (Goals/Refunds:Launch.Design), and a name is unique within the goal. A task does not go inside a task: nest with goals, and write fine-grained checks as a Markdown checklist (- [ ]) in the task's body
- Make one inside a goal with target <goal path>.<name> of card_create; move it to another goal with in of card_update (a goal path; in: null takes it out into the goal's section). The order of work of tasks is their order within the goal (position, from 0; the app shows 1, 2, 3 …), and the planned order of goals is the number at the head of a goal's label (1. 2. …)
- priority is 高, 中 or 低 (High, Medium, Low; undecided if left out). status is the goal's state (完了 when done), workBranch the branch to work in, and MR the MR's number
- Lines: line: link in connections, with to the path of a spec card, note, freedoc, goal or task (a board card can reach a card in main by its full path)
- Read: card_read of a goal returns the paths of the cards inside (cards). A value left in a removed field comes back in strayFields, removed with strayFields of card_update (null for all). card_list narrows like a list of issues with kind (goal, task), fields ({"status": "進行中"}, {"done": false}; a list as the value matches any of them) and in (a goal path); goals come in the order of their numbers, with progress (done and of)
- What a goal or task needs: card_read with value {as: "context"} on a goal or task returns the spec rows it points at, their shapes and the implementing functions' bodies, resolved on the goal's workBranch, in one call (the way of working: about: sdd)
- A goal opens as a contents map of its cards. A task is drawn with a done check and the Markdown of its body; size of card_update resizes it (appearance; null fits the body). Read the boxes with include: ["places"] of card_read, and place them together with places of card_update ({"Goals:Refunds.Design": {"topLeft": {"x": 0, "y": 0}}})
- Former forms (items of a goal, in of card_create, the Japanese keys 状態, 優先度, 期限, PR, 担当) are refused with the current way of writing attached
- Starting, finishing, cancelling and marking done are card_action (op: start, finish, cancel, done), which writes the branch, the fields and the place in one go. A finished goal moves into the Complete section inside Goals (kind complete), a cancelled one into the Cancelled section (cancelled)

/kindKeyTexts/frame/target.from: はめ込みの指す先: 箱に入れるモックの UI のセクションのパス（例: UI/Header）。自分のいるセクションと、自分のいるセクションをはめ込み返しているセクション（輪になる）は指せない
/kindKeyTexts/frame/target.text: The path of the ui section whose mock goes in the box (for example UI/Header). Not the frame's own section, nor a section that frames it back (that would be a circle).

/ghostGuide.from:
カードゴーストは、ほかのセクションのカード（かカードゴースト）を指すショートカットです。本物は元の場所に 1 つだけで、ゴーストは置いたセクションに自分の名前を持ち、指す先を id で覚えます。
- 作る: card_create の target に <セクション>:<名前>、value に {"kind": "ghost", "target": "Schemas:User"}。根のほかどのセクションにも置け、指す先は同じ木の中で、自分のセクションのものは指せない
- パス: 置いたセクションの中では User、ほかからは Orders:User。ゴーストを通したパス（Orders:User.id）は本物の中へ続き、ゴーストのパスのまま保存する。本物の欄・ゴーストの改名と移動に付いて行く
- 変える: name で改名、target で付け替え（たどった本物が同じ種類のときだけ。輪になる向きは断る）。topLeft・section・position はカードと同じ。card_delete で消す
- 読む: kind: ghost・target・resolvesTo（本物が無ければ null で、brokenPaths にも出る）・targetKind。カード数には入らず（ghostCount）、書き出しにも出ない
- ロック中の main では、作る・消す・付け替える・改名するのは断る
/ghostGuide.text:
A card ghost is a shortcut to a card (or a card ghost) in another section. The real card exists only once, at its place; the ghost has its own name in its section and remembers what it points at by id.
- Make: target <section>:<name> of card_create, value {"kind": "ghost", "target": "Schemas:User"}. Any section but the root takes one; it points within the same tree, and not into its own section
- Paths: inside its section write User, from elsewhere Orders:User. A path through the ghost (Orders:User.id) goes on into the real card and is saved as the ghost's path. Renames of the real card's fields and of the ghost, and its moves, are followed
- Change: name renames, target re-points (only to a real card of the same kind; a loop is refused). topLeft, section and position work as for a card. card_delete deletes it
- Read: kind: ghost, target, resolvesTo (null when the real card is gone, then it is in brokenPaths too) and targetKind. It is not counted among cards (ghostCount) and not exported
- On a locked main, making, deleting, re-pointing and renaming are refused

/linesGuide.from:
線はカードとカードをつなぎます: {line（種類）, from（出る欄か行。省けば頭）, to（相手のカードかカードゴースト）, at（相手の中の着く所。省けばカード）, description（書き出しに載る）, fields（種類の欄）}。card_create は connections に線の並び、card_update は {"add": [線…], "remove": [線…]}（外すのが先。remove は書いたキーの合う 1 本。同じ線が既にある add は断る）。例: {"line": "points", "from": "buyer_id", "to": "Data:User", "at": "id", "fields": {"cardinality": "N:1"}}
- to は相手の改名・移動に付いて行く（from・at も書き換わる）。値を指す線（points と designate の線）は相手の中にだけ着く
- 種類ごとに出る所（from）・着く所（to）・1 つの所から出せる本数（max）・線の欄（fields）が決まっていて、合わないものは断る。種類は kind_list の lines。組み込み: embed（欄の型が相手になる。guide の about: entity）・points（ID で指す。欄 cardinality・when・discriminatedBy）・link（どのカードからどのカードへも。同じ木の中）・holds（store から形へ）・notes（flow から文書へ）・flow のノードの線 next・branch・else・onError・onTimeout・runs・event・peer・reads・writes・key（guide の about: flow）。mentions は本文の [[ ]] から拾い、書かない
- 読む: card_read の connections・refersTo・referencedBy。壊れた線は inspection_list の brokenPaths
/linesGuide.text:
A line joins one card to another: {line (its kind), from (the field or row it leaves; the head if left out), to (the partner card or card ghost), at (where in the partner it lands; the card if left out), description (shown in exports), fields (the kind's fields)}. card_create takes the list of lines in connections; card_update takes {"add": [line, …], "remove": [line, …]} (remove first; a remove matches the one line with the keys written; adding a line already there is refused). Example: {"line": "points", "from": "buyer_id", "to": "Data:User", "at": "id", "fields": {"cardinality": "N:1"}}
- to follows the partner's renames and moves (from and at are rewritten too). A line that points at a value (points, designate lines) lands only inside its partner
- Each kind fixes where it leaves (from) and lands (to), how many may leave one place (max) and its fields; one that does not fit is refused. The kinds are lines of kind_list. Built-in: embed (the field's type becomes the partner; guide, about: entity), points (by ID; fields cardinality, when, discriminatedBy), link (any card to any card in the same tree), holds (store to a shape), notes (flow to a document), and a flow's node lines next, branch, else, onError, onTimeout, runs, event, peer, reads, writes, key (guide, about: flow). mentions come from [[ ]] in bodies and are not written
- Read: connections, refersTo and referencedBy of card_read. Broken lines are in brokenPaths of inspection_list

/embedGuide.from: 内包（embed）の線は欄の型を相手（entity・value・enum）にします: 欄は fields に type は string など object 以外で書き、connections に {"line": "embed", "from": "<欄>", "to": "<相手>"}。読むと type: ref。object の欄・fields に無い欄（出元がありません）からの線と、線のある欄の型を変えることは断ります。線を外すと型は string に戻ります。
/embedGuide.text: An embed line makes a field's type the partner (entity, value or enum): write the field in fields with a type other than object, and {"line": "embed", "from": "<field>", "to": "<partner>"} in connections. It reads as type: ref. Refused from an object field or a field not in fields (no origin), and changing the type of a field with the line. Removed, the type becomes string.

/kindsGuide.from:
種類の定義はプロジェクトに 1 つ（branch では変わらず、main のロックも受けない）で、組み込みのあとにプロジェクトのものが並びます。kind_list で一覧、kind_read で定義の全部、kind_create で作り（target に名前、value の of に card・section・line、ほかは定義）、kind_update で変え（書いたキーだけ。null で外す）、kind_delete で消します（使われている定義は断る）。名前はカード・セクション・線と組み込みを通して 1 つの種類にだけ付き、組み込みと重ねられない（ghost・action・module・custom_goal も使えない）。dryRun: true で書かずに確かめ（ok と problems）、直して合わなくなるものは inspection_list の cardProblems・lineProblems・sectionProblems に出る。どの種類も context {purpose, use_when, not_for} を持てる（セクションと線の種類は purpose を省けば description）。組み込みの種類は kind_update で context（null で組み込みの文に戻す）と icon だけを書き換えられる。flow のノードの via の値を足すのは kind_update の target flow・value の vias（["kafka"] で入れ替え、{"add": [...], "remove": [...]} で足す・外す、null で組み込みだけに戻す）
- カードの種類（of: card）: {"label": "リスク", "color": "#C2410C", "header": ["severity"], "fields": [{"name": "severity", "fieldtype": "radio", "options": ["高", "中", "低"], "default": "中"}, {"name": "owner", "fieldtype": "person"}], "rows": [{"name": "steps", "label": "対策", "fields": [{"name": "name", "fieldtype": "text", "pattern": "identifier", "required": true}, {"name": "done", "fieldtype": "checkbox"}]}], "connectable": true}。fieldtype は text・longtext・markdown・number・checkbox・date・url・radio・dropdownlist・person・branch・mr・card・path・group・json・map で、欄は label・many・required・options・default・pattern・unique も取る。extends（省けば base。base かプロジェクトの種類）から label・description・tags・metadata を受け継ぐ。holds と opens: card-map で入れ物、opens: markdown で開くと欄 body を Markdown のエディタで、on_double_click: edit_in_place で図の上で欄 body をその場で書く。face で図の上の顔: {"top": [欄の名前…], "markdown": "<欄の名前>"}（top は頭の下の操作、markdown は Markdown で描く欄）。カードは holds にその種類を挙げたセクション（free はどれでも）か入れ物の中に置け、書き出しの型にはならない。1 枚の書き方は guide の about: <種類の名前> と project
- 定義を変えたとき: 消した欄・名前を変えた欄の値は strayFields（card_read）に残り、card_update の strayFields で消す。kind_update の renames で値も移す（[{"field": "sev", "to": "severity"}]。行の種類は {row, to}、行の欄は {row, field, to}）。カードの種類の改名は kind_update の name（カードも付いて行く）
- セクションの種類（of: section）: {"label": "鍵", "holds": ["entity", "note"], "sections": ["keys"], "opens": "relations", "icon": {"name": "key", "color": "#C2410C"}, "trees": ["main"]}。holds は入れられるカードの種類（* でどれでも）、sections は中に作れるセクションの種類（省けば自分）、icon は SF Symbols の名前と #RRGGBB、trees は直下に置ける根（main・board。省けば両方、[] でほかのセクションの中だけ）。中のセクションは section_create の type で作り、根の直下は project_update の project_tree
- 線の種類（of: line）: {"label": "確かめる", "base": "link", "look": {"color": "teal", "dash": "dashed", "begin": "none", "end": "arrow"}, "from": [{"kinds": ["entity"], "at": "card"}], "to": {"kinds": ["*"], "at": ["card", "row"]}, "max": null, "fields": [{"name": "payload", "fieldtype": "text", "required": true}], "export": {"as": "annotation", "key": "x-payloads"}}。base は embed（型が相手になる）・designate（型は変わらず相手を指す）・link（型に関係しない）。look の color は amber・blue・green・teal・violet・red・grey、dash は solid・dashed・dotted、begin・end は none・arrow・triangle・open-diamond・filled-diamond。from・to は kinds（* でどれでも）と at（card は頭、row は中の行: entity・value の欄・formatdoc の項目・処理の行・プロジェクトの種類の欄と行）、1 つの種類に行の種類がいくつもあるときは rows で絞る。max は 1 つの出元から出せる本数（null でいくつでも）。visible: false で、名指すまで図に描かない。export の as は none・comment（JSDoc と description）・annotation（加えて key の名前の x- の注記）・schema（データの欄から形への線。json-data が形の JSON Schema を書く）
- 状態遷移（状態と、状態から状態への移り）は種類と線で作らず flow で書く: 状態は wait（来る出来事を待つ）・eval（分かれ道）のノード、移りはノードの間の線 next・branch（欄 when に出来事）。1 枚のカードの中の行から同じカードの行への線は、図では自分への線になり描かれない
- owner・siblings・system_only は組み込みだけ
/kindsGuide.text:
Kind definitions are one set per project (they do not change per branch and are not under main's lock), the project's own after the built-in ones. kind_list lists them, kind_read reads a whole definition, kind_create makes one (the name in target, of in value: card, section or line; the rest is the definition), kind_update changes one (only the keys written; null removes a key) and kind_delete deletes one (a definition in use is refused). A name belongs to one kind across cards, sections, lines and the built-in ones, and cannot be a built-in name or ghost, action, module or custom_goal. dryRun: true checks without writing (ok and problems), and what stops fitting after a change appears in cardProblems, lineProblems and sectionProblems of inspection_list. Every kind can have a context {purpose, use_when, not_for} (for a section or line kind, description stands in for a missing purpose). For a built-in kind, kind_update can rewrite only its context (null goes back to the built-in text) and icon. More via values for flow nodes: target flow and vias in value of kind_update (["kafka"] replaces the list, {"add": [...], "remove": [...]} adds and removes, null goes back to the built-in ones)
- Card kind (of: card): {"label": "Risk", "color": "#C2410C", "header": ["severity"], "fields": [{"name": "severity", "fieldtype": "radio", "options": ["High", "Medium", "Low"], "default": "Medium"}, {"name": "owner", "fieldtype": "person"}], "rows": [{"name": "steps", "label": "Mitigations", "fields": [{"name": "name", "fieldtype": "text", "pattern": "identifier", "required": true}, {"name": "done", "fieldtype": "checkbox"}]}], "connectable": true}. fieldtype is text, longtext, markdown, number, checkbox, date, url, radio, dropdownlist, person, branch, mr, card, path, group, json or map, and a field also takes label, many, required, options, default, pattern and unique. extends (base if left out; base or a project kind) passes on label, description, tags and metadata. holds and opens: card-map make a container; opens: markdown opens the field body in the Markdown editor; on_double_click: edit_in_place writes the field body in place on the diagram. face draws the card: {"top": [field name, …], "markdown": "<field name>"} (top: controls under the header; markdown: a field drawn as Markdown). A card goes in a section that lists the kind in holds (free takes any) or in a container, and does not become an export type. How to write one card: guide, about: <kind name> with project
- After a change: the values of deleted or renamed fields stay in strayFields (card_read) and are removed with strayFields of card_update. renames of kind_update moves the values too ([{"field": "sev", "to": "severity"}]; a kind of row {row, to}; a field of a row {row, field, to}). name of kind_update renames a card kind (the cards follow)
- Section kind (of: section): {"label": "Keys", "holds": ["entity", "note"], "sections": ["keys"], "opens": "relations", "icon": {"name": "key", "color": "#C2410C"}, "trees": ["main"]}. holds is the card kinds it takes (* for any), sections the kinds of section made inside it (itself if left out), icon an SF Symbols name and #RRGGBB, and trees the roots it can sit directly under (main, board; both if left out; [] only inside another section). A section inside is made with type of section_create; the sections directly under the roots are project_tree of project_update
- Line kind (of: line): {"label": "Verifies", "base": "link", "look": {"color": "teal", "dash": "dashed", "begin": "none", "end": "arrow"}, "from": [{"kinds": ["entity"], "at": "card"}], "to": {"kinds": ["*"], "at": ["card", "row"]}, "max": null, "fields": [{"name": "payload", "fieldtype": "text", "required": true}], "export": {"as": "annotation", "key": "x-payloads"}}. base is embed (the type becomes the partner's), designate (the type stays, and it points at the partner) or link (unrelated to types). color of look is amber, blue, green, teal, violet, red or grey, dash solid, dashed or dotted, begin and end none, arrow, triangle, open-diamond or filled-diamond. from and to are kinds (* for any) and at (card is the head; row a row inside: the fields of entity and value, formatdoc items, process steps, and the fields and rows of own kinds); rows narrows the kinds of row when a kind has several. max is the number of lines from one origin (null for any). visible: false keeps it out of diagrams until named. as of export is none, comment (JSDoc and description), annotation (also an x- annotation named by key) or schema (a line from a data field to a shape; json-data writes the shape's JSON Schema)
- Write state transitions as a flow, not as a kind and a line: states are wait nodes (waiting for an event) and eval nodes (a fork), transitions are next and branch lines between them (the event in when). A line from a row of a card to a row of the same card is a line to itself on a diagram and is not drawn
- owner, siblings and system_only are for built-in kinds only

/nodesGuide.from:
flow は入れ物のカードで、ノード（begin・process・run・eval・wait・join・end）はその中のカードです。パスは <flow のパス>.<ノードの名前>（Behavior:Checkout.review）で、名前は flow の中で一意。flow の中にはノードだけ、ノードは flow の中にだけ置けます。
- 作る: flow とノードは 1 回の card_create で、target を省いて value をパスごとに（flow が先に作られ、ノードの線は順不同に互いを指せる。例は example）。ノード 1 つは target にそのパス
- batch でノードを 1 手ずつ作るときは、線の先のノードを先に作る（手は前から順に流れ、あとの手で作るノードは指せない）か、まとめて 1 つの card_create で作る
- ノードの間の線: next（begin・process・run・wait・join から。2 本以上で並列に分かれ、join で合わせる）・branch（eval から。欄 when。並びの順に当てる）・else（eval から 1 本。必須）・onError（run から）・onTimeout（wait から）。to は同じ flow のノードの名前。ほかの flow へは runs・event・peer（同じプロセスの中で別の flow を呼んで振り分けるのは run ノードと runs の線。peer は送る・受ける相手で、相手の側にも send か receive の行が要る）、処理の行の reads・writes・key は from に steps[0] など。ノードの種類ごとのキーは guide の about: <ノードの種類>
- 読む: card_read の flow は中のノード（cards）と届かないノード（unreachable。無いときはキーごと出ません）。as: markdown で flowchart とノード全部を 1 本で。name で改名すると線も付いて行き、ノードを消すとそこへの線も外れ、flow を消すと中のノードも消える
- wait の待つ条件: for は approval（承認）・timer（時間）・event（線 event の flow の終わり）で、欄は timeout（期限）しかありません。timer の「〜まで待つ」は timeout に文で書きます（"1 day"・"翌営業日 9:00 まで"）。期限が切れたときの行き先は線 onTimeout
- 誤り（begin が 2 つ・ノードに書けないキーなど）は断り、書き途中のもの（つながっていないノード・足りない線）は warnings で知らせます
/nodesGuide.text:
A flow is a container card, and its nodes (begin, process, run, eval, wait, join, end) are cards inside it. A node's path is <flow path>.<node name> (Behavior:Checkout.review), and the name is unique within the flow. Only nodes go in a flow, and nodes go only in a flow.
- Make: a flow and its nodes in one card_create, with target left out and value keyed by path (the flow is made first, and the nodes' lines may point at each other in any order; see example). One node: its path in target
- In a batch, one node per step: make the node a line points at first (steps run in order), or all the nodes in one card_create
- Lines between nodes: next (from begin, process, run, wait, join; two or more split into parallel paths brought together at a join), branch (from eval, with the field when; tried in the order listed), else (one from an eval; required), onError (from run) and onTimeout (from wait); to is the name of a node in the same flow. To other flows: runs, event, peer (dispatching to another flow inside the same process is a run node with a runs line; peer is for the flow sent to or received from, and the other side needs a send or receive row too); a process step's reads, writes and key leave from steps[0] and so on. Each node kind's keys: guide, about: <node kind>
- Read: card_read of a flow gives its nodes (cards) and those not reachable from the start (unreachable; the key is left out when there are none); as: markdown gives the flowchart and every node in one text. Renaming a node with name takes its lines along, deleting a node removes the lines to it, and deleting a flow deletes its nodes
- Waiting: for is approval, timer or event (the end of a flow named by an event line), and the only field is timeout. Write "until" for a timer in timeout as a phrase ("1 day", "until 9:00 on the next business day"); where it goes when time runs out is the onTimeout line
- Errors (two begins, a key a node cannot take) are refused; what is still being written (nodes not connected yet, missing lines) is told in warnings

/ownKindGuide.from:
プロジェクトの種類（kind_create で作ったもの）のカードの書き方。
- 作る: card_create の value の kind にその名前、欄と行はその名前で書く（例: {"target": "Risks:Outage", "value": {"kind": "risk", "label": "停止", "severity": "高", "steps": [{"name": "backup"}]}}）。置けるのは、holds にその種類を挙げたセクション（組み込みの free はどれでも）と、holds に挙げた入れ物の中（target を <入れ物のパス>.<名前>）
- 変える: card_update の value に変える欄と行だけ（行は丸ごと置き換え）。線は connections（card_update では {add, remove}）
- 読む: card_read は定義の欄と行を名前で返し、定義から消した欄・名前を変えた欄の値を strayFields（所 → 値）で返す。card_update の strayFields（null で全部、{"<所>": null} でその所だけ）で消す
- 絞る: card_list の value の kind にその名前、fields で欄の値
- 点検: 定義に合わなくなったカードは inspection_list の組 cardProblems、定義に無い欄の所は strayFields
- 書き出しの型にはならない。図と文書には出る
/ownKindGuide.text:
How to write cards of a project's own kinds (those made with kind_create).
- Create: the kind's name as kind in value of card_create, and the fields and rows by their names (for example, {"target": "Risks:Outage", "value": {"kind": "risk", "label": "Outage", "severity": "high", "steps": [{"name": "backup"}]}}). A card can be placed in a section that lists the kind in holds (the built-in free takes any), and inside a container that lists it in holds (target <container path>.<name>)
- Change: only the fields and rows to change in value of card_update (a row is replaced whole). Lines go in connections ({add, remove} in card_update)
- Read: card_read returns the definition's fields and rows by name, and the values of fields removed from the definition or renamed in strayFields (place → value). Remove them with strayFields of card_update (null for all, {"<place>": null} for one place)
- Narrow: the kind's name as kind in value of card_list, and field values in fields
- Inspection: cards that no longer fit the definition are in the group cardProblems of inspection_list, and places with fields the definition does not have in strayFields
- It does not become an export type. It does appear in diagrams and documents

/revGuide.from:
rev はカードの版です。card_read・card_create・card_update はカードごとに rev を返し（フィールド・行・ノードは持ち主のカードの rev）、batch の実行は revs（パス → rev）を返します。
- 読んだ値をもとに書くときは、読んだ rev を card_update・card_delete の value の rev に添えます。そのあとカードが変わっていれば何も書かずに断り、今の rev と最後の書き手・時刻を返します。読み直してやり直します
- 時間切れで答えの無かった書き込みは、rev を添えて送り直します。断られたら読み直し、送った中身が入っていれば最初のが通っています（同じキーを多くのセッションが使うので、書き手の名前だけでは決めない）
- どの target（カード・フィールド・行・ノード・値）にも rev を書けます。target を省いてパスごとに書くときは、パスごとに {rev}
/revGuide.text:
rev is a card's revision. card_read, card_create and card_update return rev for each card (a field, row or node gives its owner card's), and a batch run returns revs (path → rev).
- When you write based on a value you read, add the rev you read as rev in value of card_update or card_delete. If the card changed since, nothing is written and the refusal carries the current rev and the last writer and time. Read again and redo it
- Resend a write that timed out with rev. If the resend is refused, read again; if what you sent is there, the first attempt went through (the same key is used by many sessions, so do not judge by the writer's name alone)
- rev can be written for any target (card, field, row, node, value). Writing to several paths with target left out, give {rev} for each path

/pagingGuide.from:
一覧と本文は既定の量で切って返します: 一覧は 100 件（card_list は 20 枚）と 4 万字まで、本文は 400 行まで。
- 答えに truncated: true があれば続きがあります。一覧は答えの next を value の after に渡し（ほかのキーは同じに）、limit で 1 回の件数を決めます
- 本文（card_read）は value の lines: {from, to}（行の番号は 1 から）で一部を読みます。答えに lineCount。value の find で、先に文字を含む行を探せます
- 4 万字を超える図は depth を下げ、それでも超えればセクションを箱にまとめ、truncated: true と絞り方を添えます
- entity・value の fields は入れ子まで返します（4 万字を超える所で切って truncated）。formatdoc の項目は見出しと中の行の数（rowCount）で、中は項目のパスで読みます。カードの多いプロジェクトでは card_list を section・kind・tags・query で絞ります
/pagingGuide.text:
Lists and bodies are cut at a default size: lists at 100 items (card_list at 20 cards) and 40,000 characters, bodies at 400 lines.
- An answer with truncated: true has more. For a list, pass the answer's next as after in value (with the other keys the same); limit sets how many come at a time
- A body (card_read) is read in part with lines: {from, to} in value (line numbers start at 1); the answer has lineCount. find in value first finds the lines holding a text
- A diagram over 40,000 characters lowers depth, and if still over, sums sections up into boxes, with truncated: true and how to narrow it
- The fields of an entity or value come down to every nested one (cut where they pass 40,000 characters, with truncated). A formatdoc's item comes as its heading and how many rows it holds (rowCount); read inside it by the item's path. In a project with many cards, narrow card_list with section, kind, tags or query

/pathsGuide.from:
パスは <セクション>/<セクション>:<カード>.<名前>… で、どの branch でも同じです。
- カードの中: フィールドと行は名前で（Core:User.profile.avatar.url）、formatdoc の項目（Docs:Spec.auth.login）、stackdoc の版（Docs:Notes.v2）、入れ物の中のカード（Behavior:Checkout.review・Goals:Launch.Design）、enum の値（Schemas:Status.paid）、process の手は場所で（Behavior:Checkout.save.steps[0]。線の from と同じ書き方）
- 並び: Store:Order.lines[].sku（[] は省いてもよい）。データの並びの要素は条件 Data:Host1.ports[number=8200,protocol=tcp]（値に , ] = を含むなら "" で囲む。値そのものの並びは groups[=web]）か添字 Data:Host1.ports[0]
- 囲み: 空白と / : . [ ] ' @ | { } # " ` を含む名前は一重引用符で囲む（'release notes.md'。中の ' は ''）
- value の中のパスはセクションを省ける（target のカードのセクションから読み、フルパスで保存）。カードゴーストを通したパス（Orders:User.id）は本物の中を読み、ゴーストのパスのまま残る
- 本文と説明: [[パス]] で指す（mentions の線）、[[セクション:]] でセクションを指す（押すとセクションマップ）、[[パス|見せる字]] で見せる字を変える（改名ではパスだけ書き直す）、{{パス}} で値を差し込む（欄の const・列挙の値・データの値）、![[パス]] で図を入れる（![[Data:Order1|total]] で欄を出す）。コードの書式（`…` と ``` のブロック）の中の [[ ]]・{{ }}・![[ ]] は拾わない。どれも改名・移動に付いて行く
- 答えはフルパスで返します。パスが解決するかは card_read の value {as: "exists"}
/pathsGuide.text:
A path is <section>/<section>:<card>.<name>…, the same on every branch.
- Inside a card: fields and rows by name (Core:User.profile.avatar.url), a formatdoc item (Docs:Spec.auth.login), a stackdoc version (Docs:Notes.v2), a card inside a container (Behavior:Checkout.review, Goals:Launch.Design), an enum's value (Schemas:Status.paid), a process step by its place (Behavior:Checkout.save.steps[0], as a line's from names it)
- Lists: Store:Order.lines[].sku ([] may be left out). An element of a list in data by a condition, Data:Host1.ports[number=8200,protocol=tcp] (wrap a value holding , ] or = in ""; a list of plain values groups[=web]), or by an index, Data:Host1.ports[0]
- Quoting: a name holding a space or / : . [ ] ' @ | { } # " ` is wrapped in single quotes ('release notes.md'; a ' inside is written '')
- A path inside value may leave out the section (read from the section of target's card, saved as the full path). A path through a card ghost (Orders:User.id) reads the real card and stays the ghost's path
- Bodies and descriptions: [[path]] points (a mentions line), [[section:]] points at a section (a click opens its section map), [[path|shown text]] shows other words (a rename rewrites only the path), {{path}} inserts a value (a field's const, an enum value, a data value), ![[path]] inserts a diagram (![[Data:Order1|total]] shows a field). Inside code formatting (`…` and ``` blocks) none of [[ ]], {{ }} and ![[ ]] is picked up. All follow renames and moves
- Answers give full paths. Whether paths resolve: value {as: "exists"} of card_read

/sddGuide.from:
# SDD（仕様を先に書き、実装してから main へ）

main は実装済みの形、branch は変更の計画です。仕様と設計は goal の branch に書き、実装が済んでから main へ merge します。

## 流れ

1. ボード（branch: _project_board_）に goal を作り、中に task（決めることの塊）を置く。card_action の op: start で branch ができ、goal の workBranch に入る（about: board）
2. その branch に書く: 仕様は formatdoc の項目に Given・When・Then、形は entity・value・enum、処理と状態の移り変わりは flow（wait と、eval の when で分ける。about: flow）
3. 実装は branch を読んで進める。card_read の as: context に goal か task を渡すと、指している仕様の行・形・実装の関数の本文が 1 回で返る（workBranch の branch で解く）。仕様から実装へは線 implementedBy（ファイルか、その中の関数と型へ。まだ無いものも指せ、goal の branch では点検の情報に出る。about: connections）
4. 実装で変わった所・implementedBy・テストへの線を branch に書き戻す。branch_read の as: diff で変えたものを、path を足すと前と後の中身を読む
5. 実装が済んだら branch_merge で main へ入れ（ロック中は MR）、card_action の op: finish で goal を閉じる。まだ無いファイルへの線が残っていれば warnings に出る

書き出し（export_execute）は branch も名指せ、targetdir に作業木のパスを渡すとリポジトリの branch へ書けます。

## 置き方の見本

- API・設定ファイル・メッセージの形: 種類 definition のセクションに、形の entity と、その実例の instance（of に形のパス）を置く。並べた表は table、JSON にするのは書き出しの形式 json-data（about: instance・table）
- テスト: kind_create でテストの束の種類（例 testsuite）と、仕様の項目からそこへ引く線の種類（例 verifiedBy）を作る（about: ownKinds）
- CI など人のいない所から: プロジェクト設定の MCP で、使う項目を許可にしておけば request: true は要らない。ロック中の main へは、aiMerge が true なら MR なしで入る（どちらも人が画面で決める）

## 読む順

paths → branch → board → 書く種類（about: formatdoc・entity・flow）→ connections。用語集（glossary）は画面の言葉が要るときだけ
/sddGuide.text:
# SDD (write the spec first, merge into main after implementing)

main is what is implemented, and a branch is a plan for changes. Write the spec and design on the goal's branch, and merge into main once they are implemented.

## The loop

1. On the board (branch: _project_board_), make a goal and put tasks (each a set of things to decide) in it. card_action op: start makes a branch and puts it in the goal's workBranch (about: board)
2. Write on that branch: the spec as formatdoc items with Given, When and Then; shapes as entity, value and enum; processing and state changes as flows (wait, and eval branching on when; about: flow)
3. Implement by reading the branch. card_read as: context on a goal or task returns the spec rows it points at, their shapes and the bodies of the implementing functions in one call (read on the workBranch). From the spec to the code, draw implementedBy lines (to a file, or a function or type in it; one not there yet may be named, and on a goal's branch it is information in the inspection; about: connections)
4. Write back what changed while implementing, the implementedBy lines and the lines to tests on the branch. branch_read as: diff lists what changed; add path to read the before and after
5. When implemented, branch_merge into main (an MR while main is locked) and close the goal with card_action op: finish. Lines to files not there yet are said in warnings

export_execute takes a branch too: pass a worktree's path as targetdir to write into the repository's branch.

## Where things go

- The shape of an API, a settings file or a message: in a section of kind definition, the shape as an entity and its examples as instances (of: the shape's path). table lists them; the export format json-data makes JSON (about: instance, table)
- Tests: make a kind for a test suite (say testsuite) and a kind of line from spec items to it (say verifiedBy) with kind_create (about: ownKinds)
- From CI or anywhere with no one watching: allow the items it uses in Project Settings > MCP, and request: true is not needed. Into a locked main, a merge goes in with no MR when aiMerge is true (a person sets both in the app)

## What to read, in order

paths, branch, board, the kinds you write (about: formatdoc, entity, flow), connections. Read glossary only for the app's words

/bodyGuide.from:
本文は note・freedoc・goal・task の Markdown と、svg の SVG・html の HTML です（プロジェクトの種類の markdown・longtext の欄、formatdoc の text の行の body、stackdoc の版の body も同じ）。文字列で丸ごと置き換え、{edit, append, prepend} で全部を送らずに一部を直します:
- edit: [{old, new}] を上から順に当てます。old は書いたとおりの文字で、本文のちょうど 1 か所に合わなければなりません（合わない・2 か所以上は何も書かずに断る。all: true で合う所を全部）。直す所は先に card_read の value の find か lines で見ます
- append・prepend は終わり・初めに行を足します
- 一部を直した答えは、本文の代わりに lineCount・chars と changed（直した所ごとに、その行と前後の行）を返します
- bodyFrom: {directory, path}（card_create・card_update。body の代わり。value の一番上と、rows の text の行・versions の版の中でも）は、プロジェクトに登録した作業ディレクトリの中のファイルの中身（UTF-8 の文字）を本文に写します。写したあとはカードが正本で、ファイルとは結び付かず、中身はカードのデータになります。ファイルは書き終えてから呼びます。1 回の呼び出しで読むファイルは合わせて 8 MB まで。作業ディレクトリの外へ出るパス・無いファイル・UTF-8 でないもの・本文の上限を超えるもの・body と一緒は断ります。本文の無い所に書くと、ファイルを読む前に断ります。答えに bodyFrom（[{at, directory, path, chars}]）
/bodyGuide.text:
A body is the Markdown of a note, freedoc, goal or task, the SVG of an svg and the HTML of an html (and an own kind's markdown and longtext fields, the body of a formatdoc text row and of a stackdoc version). A string replaces it whole; {edit, append, prepend} changes part of it without sending it all:
- edit: [{old, new}] is applied in order. old is the text exactly as written and must match exactly one place in the body (none or two or more: refused, nothing written; all: true replaces every match). Look at the place first with find or lines in value of card_read
- append and prepend add lines at the end and at the start
- The answer to a partial change returns, instead of the body, lineCount, chars and changed (each changed place with its lines and the lines around them)
- bodyFrom: {directory, path} (card_create, card_update; instead of body; at the top of value and also inside a text row of rows and a version of versions) copies the text (UTF-8) of a file in a working directory registered in the project into the body. Afterwards the card is the original and is not tied to the file, and the text becomes the card's data. Finish writing the file before the call. One call reads 8 MB of files at the most, all together. A path leading outside the working directory, a missing file, one that is not UTF-8, one over the body's limit and bodyFrom with body are refused. A place with no body is refused before the file is read. The answer has bodyFrom ([{at, directory, path, chars}])

/layoutGuide.from:
図の上の位置はマス（横はカードの幅の 1/10、縦はカードの 1 行。表計算のセルのように）で書きます。見かけなのでコミットにならず、ロック中の main にも書けます。
- topLeft {x, y}（card_create・card_update）でカードをセクションに置きます（goal・flow の中のカードはその入れ物のコンテンツマップに）。ほかのカードかその周りの余白に重なれば、近い空いたマスへ置いて warnings で知らせます
- UI のセクション（ui）は、書いた位置のまま置きます（箱のあいだの 1 マスの間も、重なりを飛ばすことも無く、部品を隙間なく並べ、重ねて置けます。画面で動かしたときも）
- size {w} で幅だけ（高さは中身から）、{w, h} で両方を決めます。枠のあるカードはどれも持て（flow のノードとカードゴーストは除く）、送った形がそのまま大きさです（null で既定に戻す）。広げてほかのカードに新しく重なれば、動かさずに warnings で知らせます
- places {<カードのパス>: {topLeft}} でまとめて置きます: goal の中のカードは card_update、セクションの図（ほかのセクションのカードとセクションゴーストも）は section_update。全部置いてから重なりを見て、重なったものだけを近い空いたマスへ動かし jumped で返します。読むのは section_read・card_read（goal）の include: ["places"]
- section_update は move・arrange・tidy でいくつもまとめて動かし・並べ・整えます
- プロジェクトのマスの大きさは project_update の layout:
/layoutGuide.text:
Places on a diagram are written in cells (horizontally 1/10 of a card's width, vertically one line of a card, like spreadsheet cells). They are appearance: they make no commit and can be written to a locked main.
- topLeft {x, y} (card_create, card_update) places a card in its section (a card inside a goal or flow: on the container's contents map). If it overlaps another card or the margin around one, it is placed in the nearest free cell and warnings says so
- A ui section keeps a position as written: no one-cell margin and no jumping off an overlap, so parts sit edge to edge and one over another (also when moved on the screen)
- size {w} sets the width only (height from the contents), {w, h} both; any boxed card can have one (not flow nodes or card ghosts), and what is sent is the size (null goes back). If it newly overlaps another card, the card is not moved and warnings says so
- places {<card path>: {topLeft}} places several at once: a goal's inner cards with card_update, a section's diagram (cards of other sections and section ghosts too) with section_update. All are placed first, then only the overlapping ones move to the nearest free cell and come back in jumped. Read them with include: ["places"] of section_read or card_read (a goal)
- section_update also moves, arranges and tidies many at once (move, arrange, tidy)
- The project's cell sizes are layout of project_update:
