/description.from: プロジェクトそのもの（説明・設定・main の種類ごとのカードの数・タグ・根の直下のセクションの並び・カードの大きさ・使っている大きさ）を返します。archived は読むだけのプロジェクト、locked は main のロック、aiMerge はロック中の main への自動 merge、access はこのアクセスキーでの access、mcpAsk・mcpDenied は、このプロジェクトで MCP からは都度承認（request: true で画面に許可を求める）・拒否の項目（ツール名。人がプロジェクト設定の「MCP」のタブで決める）で、無ければ出ません。counts は main の種類ごとのカードの数（ghost はカードゴースト）、tags・tagGroups はタグとタググループ（declaredTags はグループにあって、まだどのカードにも付いていないタグ）、projectTree は根の直下のセクションの並び（main_sections・board_sections。変えるのは project_update の project_tree）、layout はカードの大きさ（変えるのは project_update の layout）、size はプロジェクトが DB の中で使っている大きさ（バイト。content は中身、history は履歴、historyByBranch は木ごと）、exportLanguage は書き出し・mermaid・flow の文書でアプリが作る文の言語（ja・en。変えるのは project_update の exportLanguage）です。value の as: rules で、書く場所ごとの説明（description）の決まり（プロジェクトの決まりか、無ければアプリの既定）を、決まりの文がある場所だけ返します（card.<種類>.description のように広い場所の決まりに従う所は、place で名指すと、その決まりと setAt）。書く前に読みます。木ごとの点検（壊れたパスなど）は inspection_list、全体の図は branch_read の value の as: diagram、セクションは section_list、種類の定義は kind_list・kind_read、branch は branch_list で読みます。
/description.text: Returns the project itself (description, settings, the number of cards per kind in main, tags, the order of the sections directly under the root, the card size, and the size in use). archived is a read-only project, locked is the lock on main, aiMerge is auto-merge into a locked main, access is the access with this access key, and mcpAsk and mcpDenied are the items that are set to Ask each time (request: true asks the app for permission) and to Deny from MCP in this project (tool names; a person decides them on the MCP tab of Project Settings), and they are not shown when there are none. counts is the number of cards per kind in main (ghost is card ghosts), tags and tagGroups are the tags and tag groups (declaredTags are tags that are in a group and not yet on any card), projectTree is the order of the sections directly under the root (main_sections and board_sections; change it with project_tree of project_update), layout is the card size (change it with layout of project_update), and size is how much of the DB the project uses (in bytes; content is the contents, history is the history, historyByBranch is the history per tree), and exportLanguage is the language of the words the app writes of its own in exports, mermaid and flow documents (ja or en; change it with exportLanguage of project_update). With as: rules in value, returns the writing rules (per place) for descriptions (the project's rules, or the app's defaults if it has none), only for the places that have a rule sentence (for a place that follows the rule of a broader place, such as card.<kind>.description, name it with place to get that rule and setAt). Read it before writing. Inspections per tree (broken paths and so on) are read with inspection_list, the overall diagram with as: diagram in the value of branch_read, sections with section_list, kind definitions with kind_list and kind_read, and branches with branch_list.

/description.text: Creates a project (a new name in project, in any language). The sections Docs, Schemas, Definitions, Charts and Free are added directly under the root of main and the section Goals directly under the root of the board (the default of project_tree; change it later with project_tree in the value of project_update), and the app does not switch to it. The slug, which becomes the export file name, is made automatically. It can be created when the access key's item project_create is Allow (or Ask each time, with request: true); the created project is private and can be read and written with this access key. The export language (exportLanguage of project_read) starts as English, the language of MCP answers. Renaming is name of project_update, and deleting is done only in the app.

/description.from: プロジェクトで使える種類（カード・セクション・線）を 1 つ 1 行で返します（カードやセクションを書く前に読みます）。組み込みはこのプロジェクトに置き場のあるものだけ（builtin: true）、そのあとにプロジェクトの種類（置き場の無いものは noPlace: true）。1 つは名前・表示名（label）・何のためか（purpose）・使うとき（use_when）・使わないとき（not_for）と、置ける所: カードの種類は置けるセクションと入れ物の種類（in。free のセクションはどれでも置ける）、セクションの種類は置けるカード（holds）・中に作れる親（in）・根の直下に置ける木（trees）、線の種類は出る種類（from）と着く種類（to）。組み込みの使う場面（セクションの種類は印も）をプロジェクトで書き換えたものは contextChanged: true（印は iconChanged: true、flow の via の値を足したものは viasChanged: true）。定義の全部は kind_read。
/description.text: Returns the kinds (card, section and line) usable in the project, one per line (read it before writing cards or sections). Built-in kinds are only those that have a place to be put in this project (builtin: true), followed by the project's own kinds (noPlace: true for those with no place to be put). Each one has the name, display name (label), what it is for (purpose), when to use it (use_when), when not to use it (not_for), and where it can be put: for a card kind, the sections and container kinds it can be put in (in; a free section takes any), for a section kind, the cards it can hold (holds), the parents it can be created in (in) and the trees where it can be put directly under the root (trees), and for a line kind, the kind it leaves from (from) and the kind it arrives at (to). A built-in kind whose usage context (and, for a section kind, its icon) was rewritten in the project has contextChanged: true (iconChanged: true for the icon, and viasChanged: true when values were added to the via of flow). The whole definition is in kind_read.

/description.from: 種類の定義の全部を返します（target に種類の名前、配列で複数、省けば全部をカード・セクション・線の並びで）。of は種類の別（card・section・line）、組み込みは builtin: true（プロジェクトが使う場面を書き換えたものは、その context と contextChanged: true。組み込みのセクションの種類は icon（ナビの印。{name, color}）も持ち、書き換えたものは iconChanged: true。flow は vias（ノードの via に使える値の全部。プロジェクトが足したら viasChanged: true）も持つ）、置き場の無いものは noPlace: true。名前はカード・セクション・線を通して 1 つの種類にだけ付くので、名前だけで読めます。target を省いて全部を読むときは、カード・セクション・線の種類を合わせて 100 件までで切ります（続きは value の after）。
/description.text: Returns the whole definition of a kind (put the name of the kind in target; an array for several; leave it out for all, as a list of cards, sections and lines). of is the category of the kind (card, section or line), and built-in kinds have builtin: true (one whose usage the project rewrote has its context and contextChanged: true; a built-in section kind also has icon (the Navigator icon: {name, color}), and a rewritten one has iconChanged: true; flow also has vias (all the values usable in the via of nodes; viasChanged: true if the project added some)), and a kind with no place to be put has noPlace: true. A name belongs to only one kind across cards, sections and lines, so a name alone is enough to read it. When reading all by leaving out target, the card, section and line kinds together are cut at 100 (the rest is after in value).

/description.text: Creates a project kind (card, section or line), with the name in target, the category in the of of value (card, section or line) and the rest as the definition. A name cannot duplicate a built-in kind or another kind (it is one name across cards, sections and lines). The definition is checked against the built-in ones, and all the errors are listed when it is refused. With dryRun: true, it checks without writing and returns ok and problems. The shape of a definition is in guide, about: kind_create. It exists once per project, does not change per branch, and is not affected by the lock on main. The answer is {created: [name]}.

/description.from: 種類を変えます（target に名前）。プロジェクトの種類は、value に書いた定義のキーだけを置き換え（null で外す）、name で名前を変え（カードの種類だけ。その種類のカードも付いて行く）、renames で欄・行の種類・行の欄の名前を変えて値も移します（定義の中の名前も変わる）。組み込みの種類は context（purpose・use_when・not_for）と、セクションの種類は icon（ナビの印。{name, color}）だけを書き換えられ、書いたキーが組み込みの文と印に代わります（context: null・icon: null で組み込みに戻す）。flow は vias でノード（begin・処理の行・run）の via に使える値を足せます（名前は英小文字・数字・-。使われている値は外せない）。直して合わなくなるカードは inspection_list の組 cardProblems・lineProblems・sectionProblems に出ます。dryRun: true で書かずに確かめます。答えは変えた種類の定義（kind_read と同じ形）。
/description.text: Changes a kind (the name goes in target). For a project's own kind, only the definition keys written in value are replaced (null removes one), name renames it (card kinds only; the cards of that kind follow), and renames changes the names of fields, kinds of row and fields of a row and moves the values too (names inside the definition change as well). A built-in kind can have only its context (purpose, use_when, not_for) rewritten, and for a section kind its icon (the Navigator icon: {name, color}); the keys you write replace the built-in text and icon (context: null and icon: null return to the built-in ones). For flow, vias adds values that can be used in the via of nodes (begin, the rows of process, and run) (a name is lowercase letters, digits and -; a value in use cannot be removed). Cards that no longer fit after a change appear in the groups cardProblems, lineProblems and sectionProblems of inspection_list. With dryRun: true it checks without writing. The answer is the definition of the changed kind (the same shape as kind_read).

/description.text: Returns the project's sections in tree order, with their kind (type) and number of cards (card ghosts are not counted; ghostCount is added if there are any). The top is the root of main, marked main: true. Directly under it are the sections given by the project's project_tree (in the listed order, with the set-aside section _evacuation_ last if there is one), and the other sections are inside them. A working directory is a section of the kind workdir directly under the root (with files, how many files were read, and directories, how many directories), and the directories in it are listed only when value's section names it or one inside it. Rules are project settings, not sections (project_read). Card names are unique within a section. Branches are seen with branch_list. It is cut at 100 (the rest is after in value).

/description.text: Returns the contents of one section (kind, description, cards (card ghosts come after the cards) and the sections inside it). With include: ["places"] in value, the diagram's boxes get their positions in places (cards of other sections placed there too; the keys are the paths section_update's places writes: a card's path, a section ghost's section path). With as: diagram in value, it returns in mermaid the Section map diagram of that section and of the cards of other sections that it points to or that point to it (a section that has data (instance) and none of entity, value, enum or store gets a flowchart of the data and lines; inner sections are subgraphs, lines are labeled with the value of the condition where they arrive; the same diagram as `![[…]]` in a body; the cards of the section are drawn even if they have no lines; roots, depth, kinds, tags, fields, direction and revisionOnly, and how it answers over 40,000 characters, are the same as as: diagram of card_read). as: picture gives the same map as the screen draws it, in PNG (the app draws it). For a ui section, as: mock returns its mock's HTML ({html, width, height, parts, frames}, uncut); as: picture draws the mock (view: map for the map). Cards and inner sections (and places) are cut together at 100 (the rest is after in value).

/description.from: セクションを作ります（target に作るセクションのパス。Store/Ordering なら main の Store の中に Ordering）。根の直下には作れません（main・branch とボードの根の直下はプロジェクトの project_tree で決まり、project_update の value の project_tree で書きます）。作るセクションは親の種類になります（value の type で、親の種類の定義の sections にあるプロジェクトの種類を選べます）。前後を _ で挟んだ名前はアプリが使います。名前は 255 文字までで日本語・空白・記号も使え（パスの中では区切りの字を含む名前を一重引用符で囲みます: repo/'.claude'）、兄弟の中で一意です（ASCII の大文字小文字は区別しません）。作業ディレクトリのセクションは project_update の project_tree に {"type": "workdir", "name": …} を足して作り、その中にはセクションを作れません。branch を作るのは branch_create です。
/description.text: Creates a section (the path of the section to create goes in target; Store/Ordering creates Ordering inside Store of main). It cannot be created directly under the root (what is directly under the root of main, branches and the board is decided by the project's project_tree, and written with project_tree in the value of project_update). The new section takes the kind of its parent (with type in value, you can choose a project kind listed in sections of the parent kind's definition). Names with _ on both ends are used by the app. A name can be up to 255 characters and use any language, spaces and symbols (in a path, a name holding a separator character is wrapped in single quotes: repo/'.claude'), and must be unique among siblings (ASCII case is not distinguished). A working directory's section is made by adding {"type": "workdir", "name": …} to project_tree of project_update, and no section can be created inside it. Branches are created with branch_create.

/description.from: セクションの名前・説明・並び（position）・親（parent）を変えます。作業ディレクトリのセクションは readType・exclude・parsers・description（プロジェクトの設定）と folder（この機械のフォルダ。項目 section_update.folder）も書け、読み直して section_read の形で返します（batch では書けません）。根の直下のセクション（project_tree のもの）は名前と説明だけを変えられます（名前を変えると、project_tree と、main・各 branch の同じセクションの名前も変わるので、branch を名指すと断る。並べ替えと外すのは project_tree で）。名前や親を変えると、プロジェクトに書かれたパスのうちこのセクションを指すもの（線・flow のノード・rules・`[[ ]]` と `{{ }}`。説明に書いたものも。コードの中は除く）を書き換え、その数を rewrittenPaths で返します。
/description.text: Changes the name, description, order (position) and parent (parent) of a section. A working directory's section also takes readType, exclude, parsers, description (the project's settings) and folder (this machine's folder; the item section_update.folder); it is read again and answered as section_read (not in a batch). A section directly under the root (one in project_tree) can have only its name and description changed (a rename also changes project_tree and the same section of every branch, so naming a branch is refused; reordering and removing: project_tree). A rename or move rewrites the paths in the project that point to the section (lines, flow nodes, rules, `[[ ]]` and `{{ }}`; in descriptions too, but not inside code) and returns their number as rewrittenPaths.

/forms/0/spec/properties/places/descript.text: Places the diagram boxes of this section all at once (the shape section_read reads with include places; bottomRight is only for reading and ignored). A key is the path of a card (card ghosts too) or the section path of a section ghost, and a value is {topLeft: {x, y}, size: {w, h}} (size is {w} or {w, h}, for boxed cards (not flow nodes or card ghosts) and section ghosts; null returns to the default). After placing them all, overlaps are looked at, only the overlapping ones jump to the nearest empty cell, and where they went is returned in jumped (a ui section keeps them as written and nothing jumps)

Card ghosts come after the cards, and the cards inside a container right after it with in or a node kind. goal and task list like issues with fields and in; goals come in the order of their number, with progress (done, of). implementation collects the specs and functions not linked to an implementation yet (none), and the cards with implementation lines whose code changed or is not recorded (changed, unrecorded).

/description.from: カード・フィールド・行・ノード・データの値を返します（target にパス、配列で複数）。答えの form（card・field・enumValue・datum・row）が書き方で、読んだキーのまま書けます。fields は入れ子まで点でつないだ名前の平らな並び、入れ物は中のカードのパス（cards）です。読んだ値をもとに書くときは、カードごとの rev を添えます。本文は 400 行で切ります。value の include で項目を絞り、find・lines で本文の一部を、as で別の読み方をします（as: picture は画面の図を PNG に。アプリが描く。as: context はボードの goal か task の材料: 指している仕様の行・その形・実装の関数の本文を、goal の workBranch の branch で解いて 1 回で）。そこを指す済んでいないボードのカードは fromBoard。ファイルは language と関数と型（symbols）、その先の関数と型（repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total）はコード（行はファイルの番号）。実装の線の先のコードが覚えたあとで変わったか、覚えていなければ codeReview。
/description.text: Returns a card, field, row, node or data value (the path in target; an array for several). form in the answer (card, field, enumValue, datum, row) says how it is written; write back what you read with the same keys. fields come flat, dotted down to the last nested one; a container gives its cards' paths (cards). Add each card's rev when writing what you read. A body is cut at 400 lines. include narrows the items, find and lines read part of a body, as reads it another way (as: picture: the screen's map of it in PNG, drawn by the app; as: context: what a board goal or task needs: the spec rows it points at, their shapes and the bodies of the implementing functions, resolved on the goal's workBranch, in one call). Unfinished board cards pointing at it come in fromBoard. A file: its language and functions and types (symbols); one past it (repo/src:'a.rs'.Order.total): its code (the file's line numbers). An implementation line whose code changed after it was recorded, or is not recorded: codeReview.

/description.from: カードを作ります（target にカードのパス。例: Core:User）。target をカードの中まで書くと、その中に作ります: フィールド（Core:User.email）、formatdoc の行（Docs:Spec.auth。value の before・after で置く所）、stackdoc の版、入れ物の中のカード（Behavior:Checkout.review は flow のノード、Goals:Launch.Design は goal の中の goal・task）。value には kind と、その種類のキー（fields・values・steps・body・rows など）と線（connections）をまとめて書きます。target を省いて value をパスごとにすると 1 回でいくつも作り（flow とノードは guide の about: flow）、同じ card_create の value に入れたカードは順不同に互いを線で指せます（batch の別の手で作るカードは、前の手のものだけ指せます）。kind: ghost と target でカードゴーストを作ります。名前は日本語・空白・記号も使えます（1〜255 字）。解決しないパスの warnings は、全部を書き終えてから数えます。前の形（ref・pointsAt・holds・notes・links・payloads、flow の nodes・goal の items・value の in）は書き方を添えて断ります。
/description.text: Creates a card (its path in target; for example Core:User). A target inside a card creates there: a field (Core:User.email), a formatdoc row (Docs:Spec.auth; before or after in value places it), a stackdoc version, or a card inside a container (Behavior:Checkout.review is a node of a flow, Goals:Launch.Design a goal or task in a goal). value holds kind, the kind's keys (fields, values, steps, body, rows, and so on) and the lines (connections), all at once. With target left out and value keyed by path, one call makes several (a flow and its nodes: guide, about: flow), and cards put in the value of one card_create may point at each other in any order (in a batch, a step may point only at cards earlier steps made). kind: ghost with target makes a card ghost. A name can use any language, spaces and symbols (1 to 255 characters). Warnings for paths that do not resolve are counted after everything is written. Former forms (ref, pointsAt, holds, notes, links, payloads, a flow's nodes, a goal's items, in of value) are refused with the way to write them.

Expressions (when and so on) are not interpreted. The known kinds and their arguments (* means required; every one can take field (the target field; if left out, this field or the element itself) and note (a description)): sortedBy (by or keys (a list of names of the fields to compare), and order: asc / desc), uniqueBy (by or keys), requiredIf and absentIf (when* (a condition expression) and then* (the field that is present or absent in that case)), derivedFrom (from* (the path to recompute from)), monotonicPerKey (keys* (a list of names of the fields that separate the series)), chainedBy (field* (the field holding the previous generation's digest)), memberOf (target* (the path of the set)), lteRef and gteRef (target* (the path to compare with)), pattern (regex*)

/forms/1/spec/properties/rules/descripti.from: 検証ルール [{kind, …}]。既知の kind は引数を確かめ（要る引数が無いもの・書けない引数は、書き込みで新しく入る rule なら断る）、未知の kind はそのまま保存して生成物のコメントに落とします。式（when など）は解釈しません。既知の kind と引数（* は要る。どれも field（対象の欄。省けばこの欄・要素そのもの）と note（説明）を書ける）: sortedBy（by か keys（比べる欄の名前の並び）・order: asc / desc）、uniqueBy（by か keys）、requiredIf・absentIf（when*（条件の式）・then*（そのときある・無い欄））、derivedFrom（from*（再計算の元のパス））、monotonicPerKey（keys*（系列を分ける欄の名前の並び））、chainedBy（field*（前の世代の digest の欄））、memberOf（target*（集合のパス））、lteRef・gteRef（target*（比べる相手のパス））、pattern（regex*）
/forms/1/spec/properties/rules/descripti.text: Validation rules [{kind, ...}]. A known kind has its arguments checked (a rule newly added by the write is refused if it lacks a required argument or has an argument it cannot take), and an unknown kind is saved as it is and written out as a comment in the generated output. Expressions (when and so on) are not interpreted. The known kinds and their arguments (* means required; every one can take field (the target field; if left out, this field or the element itself) and note (a description)): sortedBy (by or keys (a list of names of the fields to compare), and order: asc / desc), uniqueBy (by or keys), requiredIf and absentIf (when* (a condition expression) and then* (the field that is present or absent in that case)), derivedFrom (from* (the path to recompute from)), monotonicPerKey (keys* (a list of names of the fields that separate the series)), chainedBy (field* (the field holding the previous generation's digest)), memberOf (target* (the path of the set)), lteRef and gteRef (target* (the path to compare with)), pattern (regex*)

/description.from: カード・フィールド・行・版・ノード・データの値（target のパス）を変えます。value に渡したキーだけが変わり、配列は丸ごと置き換え、線は connections の {add, remove} です。name で改名すると、そのパスが書かれた所も書き換えます。section でほかのセクションへ、in で入れ物（flow・goal）の中のカードをほかの入れ物へ移し、position で並べます。topLeft・size・view・version・standalone・places は見かけでコミットになりません。カードゴーストを通したパス（Orders:User.id）は本物を変えます。プロジェクトの種類のカードは欄と行を名前で書きます。kind を変えるときは、新しい種類が持てないものを先に空にします（カードとカードゴーストは互いに変えられない）。前の形（flow の nodes・goal の items など）は書き方を添えて断ります。
/description.text: Changes a card, field, row, version, node or data value (the path in target). Only the keys given in value change; an array is replaced whole, and lines are connections {add, remove}. Renaming with name also rewrites that path wherever it is written. section moves a card to another section, in moves a card inside a container (flow, goal) to another one, and position orders it. topLeft, size, view, version, standalone and places are appearance and make no commit. A path through a card ghost (Orders:User.id) changes the real card. A card of a project's own kind takes its fields and rows by name. Changing kind needs what the new kind cannot hold emptied first (a card and a card ghost cannot be changed into each other). Former forms (a flow's nodes, a goal's items, and so on) are refused with the way to write them.

/forms/0/spec/properties/size/descriptio.from: カードの大きさ（マス）。{w} は幅だけを決め、高さは中身から（行の数・本文の高さ・文書のカードはプロジェクトの行数ぶん）。{w, h} は両方を決め、入らない行はカードの中でスクロールする。送った形がそのまま大きさになる（{w} は前の h を外す）。例: {"w": 20}・{"w": 20, "h": 12}。幅 4〜60・高さ 2〜120。枠のあるカードはどれも持てる（flow のノードとカードゴーストは断る）。入れ物の中のカードは、入れ物のコンテンツマップでの大きさ。見かけでコミットにならない。ほかのカードかまわりのマスに新しく重なれば、動かさずに warnings で言う。null で既定（プロジェクトの幅、高さは中身から）に戻す
/forms/0/spec/properties/size/descriptio.text: The card's size in cells. {w} sets the width only, and the height follows the contents (rows, the body's height, a document's project rows); {w, h} sets both, and rows that do not fit scroll inside the card. What is sent is the size ({w} drops an earlier h). For example {"w": 20} or {"w": 20, "h": 12}. Width 4–60, height 2–120. Any boxed card can have one (flow nodes and card ghosts are refused). For a card inside a container, the size on the container's contents map. Appearance: no commit. If it newly overlaps another card or the margin around one, the card is not moved and warnings says so. null goes back to the default (the project's width, height from the contents)

/forms/0/spec/properties/places/descript.text: Places the boxes of a goal's contents map all at once. Keys are the paths of the cards inside the goal, values are {topLeft: {x, y}} (in cells; a goal's size is the project's card size, and a task's is a height that fits its body (up to the project's card height) or the size set with size). /forms/0/spec/properties/rules/descripti.from: 検証ルール [{kind, …}]。既知の kind は引数を確かめ（要る引数が無いもの・書けない引数は、書き込みで新しく入る rule なら断る）、未知の kind はそのまま保存して生成物のコメントに落とします。式（when など）は解釈しません。既知の kind と引数（* は要る。どれも field（対象の欄。省けばこの欄・要素そのもの）と note（説明）を書ける）: sortedBy（by か keys（比べる欄の名前の並び）・order: asc / desc）、uniqueBy（by か keys）、requiredIf・absentIf（when*（条件の式）・then*（そのときある・無い欄））、derivedFrom（from*（再計算の元のパス））、monotonicPerKey（keys*（系列を分ける欄の名前の並び））、chainedBy（field*（前の世代の digest の欄））、memberOf（target*（集合のパス））、lteRef・gteRef（target*（比べる相手のパス））、pattern（regex*）
/forms/0/spec/properties/rules/descripti.text: Validation rules [{kind, ...}]. A known kind has its arguments checked (a rule newly added by the write is refused if it lacks a required argument or has an argument it cannot take), and an unknown kind is saved as it is and written out as a comment in the generated output. Expressions (when and so on) are not interpreted. The known kinds and their arguments (* means required; every one can take field (the target field; if left out, this field or the element itself) and note (a description)): sortedBy (by or keys (a list of names of the fields to compare), and order: asc / desc), uniqueBy (by or keys), requiredIf and absentIf (when* (a condition expression) and then* (the field that is present or absent in that case)), derivedFrom (from* (the path to recompute from)), monotonicPerKey (keys* (a list of names of the fields that separate the series)), chainedBy (field* (the field holding the previous generation's digest)), memberOf (target* (the path of the set)), lteRef and gteRef (target* (the path to compare with)), pattern (regex*)

/forms/1/spec/properties/rules/descripti.text: Validation rules [{kind, ...}]. A known kind has its arguments checked (a rule newly added by the write is refused if it lacks a required argument or has an argument it cannot take), and an unknown kind is saved as it is and written out as a comment in the generated output. Expressions (when and so on) are not interpreted. The known kinds and their arguments (* means required; every one can take field (the target field; if left out, this field or the element itself) and note (a description)): sortedBy (by or keys (a list of names of the fields to compare), and order: asc / desc), uniqueBy (by or keys), requiredIf and absentIf (when* (a condition expression) and then* (the field that is present or absent in that case)), derivedFrom (from* (the path to recompute from)), monotonicPerKey (keys* (a list of names of the fields that separate the series)), chainedBy (field* (the field holding the previous generation's digest)), memberOf (target* (the path of the set)), lteRef and gteRef (target* (the path to compare with)), pattern (regex*)

/description.from: カードかフィールドか行かノードを消します（target にパス）。カードはフィールドごと、フィールドと項目は中も消えます。ノードを消すと、同じ flow のノードからそこへの線も外れます。入れ物（flow・goal）を消すと、flow のノードは一緒に消え、goal の中のカードは goal のあった所（goal の入れ物か、セクション）へ出ます（warnings に出したもの）。value の rev（card_update と同じ）を添えると、読んだあとに変わっていれば何も消さずに断ります。ほかのカードからの線・本文のパス・カードゴーストは指す先なしになり、それを warnings に 1 つずつ、danglingRefs にその数を返します（main のカードを消すと、それを指していたボードのカードの分も）。カードゴーストを消すのも同じで（danglingRefs はゴーストを通して指していたもの）、本物を消すと、それを指すゴーストは指す先の無いゴーストとして残ります（brokenPaths に出る）。データ（instance）の値のパス（Data:Order1.note）なら、その値を外します（並びの要素のパス Data:Host1.ports[0] なら、その要素を並びから抜き、後ろの要素を添字で選んでいる線はずれて付いて行きます）。
/description.text: Deletes a card, field, row, or node (the path in target). A card goes together with its fields, and a field or item goes together with what is inside it. Deleting a node also removes the lines to it from the other nodes of the same flow. Deleting a container (flow or goal) deletes a flow's nodes with it, and the cards inside a goal move out to where the goal was (the goal's container, or the section) and are listed in warnings. If you pass rev in value (same as in card_update), nothing is deleted and the call is refused if the card has changed since you read it. Lines from other cards, paths in bodies, and card ghosts that pointed to the deleted card are left with nothing to point to; each is reported in warnings, and their number is returned in danglingRefs (deleting a card in main also counts the board cards that pointed to it). Deleting a card ghost works the same way (danglingRefs counts what pointed through the ghost); when you delete the real card, the ghosts that point to it remain as ghosts with nothing to point to (they appear in brokenPaths). For the path of a value of data (instance) (Data:Order1.note), it removes that value (for the path of an element of a list, Data:Host1.ports[0], the element is taken out of the list, and lines that select the later elements by index shift and follow along).

/description.from: goal・task と UI の部品（html・svg・frame）のアクション（op）と、実装の線を持つカードの見直しを 1 回で行います（target にカード 1 枚）。goal の start は branch を作って進行中に、finish は完了にしてボードの完了のセクションへ、cancel は打ち切りにして打ち切りのセクションへ移し、task の done は済みにし、reviewed は部品の見直しの印を消し、作業ディレクトリのファイルへ引いた線（implementedBy など）のコードを今の形で覚え直します（どの種類のカードでも。覚え直しはコミットにならず、ロック中の main でも使えます）。branch の作成・削除と欄と移動を 1 つのトランザクションで書きます。今使えるかは card_read の include: ["actions"]、op ごとの中身は guide の about: goal・task。
/description.text: Carries out an action (op) of a goal, a task or a ui part (html, svg, frame), or reviews a card with implementation lines, in one go (target is one card). A goal's start makes a branch and sets it in progress, finish sets it complete and moves it into the board's Complete section, cancel sets it cancelled and moves it into the Cancelled section; a task's done checks it; reviewed clears a part's review mark, and records the code of the lines to working-directory files (implementedBy and the like) as it is now (on any kind of card; recording is no commit and works on a locked main). Making and deleting the branch, the fields and the move are written in one transaction. Whether one is usable now: card_read with include: ["actions"]; what each op does: guide with about: goal or task.

/description.text: Returns exports. Always pass targetdir ([default] for each export's default destination, or the path of another folder; it shows the situation as if the export were written there, so even if you pass a path nothing is written, and it has no item). If target is omitted, for each export: the number of files, the numbers of files that changed since they were written (changed), were changed by hand (edited), are gone (missing), have not been written yet (unwritten) and would be removed by the next write (removing), and the reasons any export cannot write (problems). /description.text: Reads a tree (main, a branch or the Project Board; target is its name, and as in value is how to read it: diff, diagram or history; a tree's inspection is read with inspection_list). as: diff is what the branch changed against main and what main did after it was made (target is a branch). changed, made and removed are the cards it changed (with a line per change), made and deleted; sections* are the same for sections; main* are the same done in main after the branch was made; overlaps is what also came to exist in main at the same path; elsewhere is what other branches also changed there; merged is the merge time, if nothing has been written since. path in value (an array for several; a changed one's path now, or a removed or moved one's path before) gives each one's before (as the branch copied it) and after in changes, shaped as as: history with seq gives them (mainChanged: true when main changed it too; full: true for long texts whole; cut at 40,000 characters with next). against in value (a branch; main too) previews merging target into it (places: the positions that places: true of branch_merge would add or change; main as target: merging main in). as: diagram returns the whole tree's Section map in mermaid (keys and rev as in as: diagram of card_read). as: history returns the commits newest first (seq is for to and undo of branch_revert; kind appears when not edit (merge, revert, batch, export, record, form; the last two cannot be reverted to before that point); lines is what was done, up to 10 per commit, the rest counted in moreLines). Given seq, as: history returns what that one commit changed, before and after: changes lists the sections and cards it changed (change is add, change or remove; from is the path before); for a changed one, units gives each unit that changed with its before and after (in card_read's shape); a card made or deleted comes whole in after or before (in card_create's value shape); a part of a text over 2,000 characters changed comes as key and lines (the line in the text after, and before and after; full: true for whole texts); later lists the later commits that wrote the same one (where an undo may conflict). path gives only those cards or sections (an array for several). Positions are not included.

/description.from: target の branch（merge 元。main も可）で変えたこと全部を、value の into（merge 先。省けば main）に入れます。片側だけが変えた所はそちらを、両側が違うように変えた所は衝突として、value の take で単位ごとに選びます（3 点での比べ方と MR は guide の about: branch）。単位は行のパス（rows.<親>.<名前>・versions.<名前>）で、行は入れ子も 1 本ずつ、flow のノードの行 steps は欄ごと 1 単位です。片方が消した項目の中をもう片方が変えていれば、その項目の衝突になります。main を取り込むときは target に main、into に branch（branch は作ったときの main を見ているので、そのあと main で変わったものも入ります。places: true は使えません）。main へ入れると、merge 元の branch は退けます（一覧から外れて名前が空き、その merge を取り消す revert で戻ります）。答えの places は、places: true で入れたことで増えて変わった位置の数です。places: true を付けなかったときに入れなかった位置があれば、答えの placesLeft にその数と、取り込む hint が出ます（MR の result も同じ）。main がロック中（project_read の locked）なら、代わりに MR を出します。同じ branch でもう一度呼ぶと、前の MR は取り下げになります。project_read の aiMerge: true なら MR を出さずにそのまま main に入れ、said にそう書きます。
/description.text: Puts everything changed in the target branch (the merge source; main is allowed too) into the branch named by into in value (the merge target; main if omitted). Where only one side changed, that side is taken; where both changed it differently, it is a conflict, chosen with take by unit (the three-point comparison and MRs: guide, about: branch). A unit is a row's path (rows.<parent>.<name>, versions.<name>); nested rows are one by one, and steps, the rows of a flow node, is one unit per field. If one side deleted an item and the other changed inside it, that item is the conflict. To merge main in, give main as target and the branch as into (a branch sees the main of when it was made, so later changes in main come in too; places: true cannot be used). Put into main, the merge source is set aside (it leaves the list and its name becomes free; a revert of the merge brings it back). places in the answer counts the positions that places: true added or changed. Without places: true, positions left out show as placesLeft with a hint on taking them (an MR's result likewise). If main is locked (locked in project_read), an MR is submitted instead; calling again with the same branch withdraws the previous MR. With aiMerge: true in project_read it goes into main without an MR, and said says so.

/description.from: target の branch（main・プロジェクトボードも可）を、value の to のコミットのすぐあとの形に戻すか、value の undo のコミット 1 つだけを取り消します。main は書き換えず、戻した形の branch（value の name、省けば revert-<to> か undo-<undo>）を作って made で返します。それを branch_merge で main に入れます（ロック中は MR になり、ロック中でも作れます）。その merge で、戻した範囲の merge が退けた branch も戻ります。to は、それより新しいコミットを新しい順に取り消し、取り消した結果を「戻す」の 1 コミットとして積みます（git の revert）。undo は、そのコミットが変えた所だけを前の形へ戻し、あとのコミットが変えた所は今のまま残します。両方が変えた所が 1 つでもあれば、何も書かずに conflicts（path・unit・before・after・now）と later を返して断ります。取り消したコミットは履歴に残り、戻したことも、また戻せます。番号と中身は branch_read の value の as: history（seq で 1 つの前後）で見ます。to の範囲に、このアクセスキー以外の書き手（画面・ほかのアクセスキー）のコミットがあれば、何も書かずにそのコミットを並べて断ります。ほかの書き手のコミットは undo で 1 つずつ、MCP にさせることの項目 branch_revert.others（既定は都度承認。request: true で画面に聞く）を通ったときだけ取り消せます。カードの位置は戻りません。
/description.text: Reverts the target branch (main and the Project Board are allowed too) to the shape right after the commit given as to in value, or undoes the one commit given as undo in value. It does not rewrite main, but makes a branch with the reverted shape (name in value; revert-<to> or undo-<undo> if omitted) and returns it in made. Put it into main with branch_merge (while main is locked that becomes an MR, and the branch can be made even while it is locked). With that merge, the branches that merges in the reverted range had set aside come back too. to undoes the commits newer than that, newest first, and stacks the result of the undoing as one "revert" commit (git's revert). undo takes back only what that commit changed, keeping what later commits changed; if any place was changed by both, nothing is written and it refuses, returning conflicts (path, unit, before, after, now) and later. The undone commits stay in the history, and the revert itself can also be undone. The numbers and contents are seen with as: history in branch_read's value (seq for one commit's before and after). If the range of to has commits by writers other than this access key (the app or other access keys), nothing is written and it refuses, listing those commits. Other writers' commits can be undone one at a time with undo, only through the item branch_revert.others (asked each time by default; request: true asks the app). Card positions are not reverted.

/description.text: Reads and operates the app's window (op). state returns the open project and branch, the section, the selected card, field and row (row is the path of a formatdoc item, flow node or goal task; connections holds that card and its number of steps when the connections map is open) and how the Section map looks (zoom, visible area, drawn cards; sectionGhost is a section ghost's section path and ghost a card ghost's path; for a selected card ghost, card is the real card it lands on, null if none). select, in the window that has the project open, opens the tree of branch (main if omitted), selects the section, card or field of target there and moves the map to it (a path that tree does not have is refused without moving the window). view changes how the Section map looks (target: fit / cards / area / topLeft / center / zoom). capture returns the window as a PNG (target: window / view). windows returns the windows that have a project open that this key can read. state, select, view and capture point at a window with window in value (default: the frontmost window with project open; if project is omitted, the frontmost). It is not needed just to read and write data. state, select, view and windows need the item app_control = Allow, and capture needs app_control.capture (default: Ask each time).

/description.from: 書くツールの手をまとめて試してから、1 つのトランザクションで流します。手は value の steps に [{tool, arguments}]（arguments はそのツールを直接呼ぶときと同じ。200 手まで）。手が大きいときは、steps の代わりに stepsFrom: {directory, path} で、登録した作業ディレクトリの中の JSON ファイル（手の配列）から読みます（手の中の bodyFrom も、受けたときに 1 度だけ読みます）。execute を付けずに project（と branch。省けば main）と手を渡すと、手を試しに流すだけで、何も書かず、バッチも開かず、木も押さえません。value に open: true を付けるとバッチを開いて、その id（batch）を返します。バッチはその木を押さえ、押さえている間は画面からその木を直せません（画面の帯から人が取り消せます）。target にバッチの id を渡すと、value の steps で手を足し、remove で手を 1 つ外し、discard: true で捨てます。どれも全部の手を試しに流し直し、通らなければ何も変えずに理由を返します。前の手で作ったものを後の手で使えます。試しに流した答えの said に、書いていないことと流し方が出ます。execute: true で流します（全部通るか、何も変わらないか。target を省いて手を渡せばその場で流し、バッチの id を渡せば積んだ手を流して押さえを外します。失敗したときバッチは残ります）。警告の壊れたパスは、全部の手を流し終えた形で確かめ直すので、途中の手で壊れてあとの手で直ったものは出ません。バッチは 7 日触らなければ片付けられます。
/description.text: Tries the steps of the writing tools together, then runs them in one transaction. The steps go in steps of value as [{tool, arguments}] (arguments as when calling that tool directly; up to 200 steps). For large steps, give stepsFrom: {directory, path} (a JSON file of the steps in a working directory) instead of steps. Without execute, with project (and branch; main if omitted) and steps, it only dry-runs the steps: nothing is written, no batch opens and the tree is not held. open: true in value opens a batch and returns its id (batch). The batch holds that tree, and the app cannot edit the tree meanwhile (a person can cancel the batch from its bar). With the batch id as target, steps in value adds steps, remove takes one step out, and discard: true throws the batch away. Each call dry-runs all the steps again; if one fails, nothing changes and the reason is returned. Later steps can use what earlier ones made. said in the answer tells that nothing is written and how to run it. execute: true runs it (all pass or nothing changes; with steps and no target it runs them at once, with a batch id it runs the staged steps and releases the hold; if it fails the batch remains). Broken-path warnings are checked after all the steps, so ones a later step fixes do not appear. A batch untouched for 7 days is cleaned up.

/description.from: ツール・種類・キーの書き方を返します（一覧に載るのは説明の最初の一文と、引数と value の要約まで）。about にツール名で、そのツールが何をするか・target ごとの value のキー・答え・例・断られやすいこと。種類の名前（entity・flow など）でその種類だけのキーと例、キーや仕組みの名前（connections・body・layout・rev・paging・paths・branch・board・kinds）でその書き方、sdd で仕様を先に書いて実装する進め方。about を名前の配列にすると、1 回でいくつも読めます。プロジェクトの種類は、about にその名前と project で。glossary で画面と共通の語。省くと、名前と答えの字数の一覧。
/description.text: Returns how tools, kinds and keys are written (the list shows the first sentence of a description, and the arguments with a summary of value). With a tool name in about: what the tool does, the keys of value by what target points at, its answer, an example and the refusals easy to hit. A kind's name (entity, flow, and so on) gives the keys only that kind takes, with an example; the name of a key or mechanism (connections, body, layout, rev, paging, paths, branch, board, kinds) how to write it; sdd the way of writing the spec first and implementing it. An array of names in about reads several in one call. A project's own kind: its name in about, with project. glossary gives the terms shared with the app. Left out, the names with the size of each answer.

/description.from: 木の点検で見つかったものを 1 件ずつ id で返します（branch に木。省けば main）。hint は壊れたパスの近いものです。件は組の順、組の中は見つかった順に並びます。済んだカード（完了・打ち切りの goal、済みの task）とその中のカードで見つかった件は、記録なので直すものの組でも情報（info）に数え、kind: info が付きます。counts は木の全体の fix（直すもの）・info（設計どおりでも出る情報）・accepted（設計どおりの印を付けたもの）の数、groups は件のある組ごとの kind（fix か info）・label（見出し）・count（印の無い件の数）・info（count のうち情報に数えた件の数。直すものの組）・accepted（印の付いた件の数）で、どちらも絞る前の全体です。直すものの組は brokenPaths（解決しないパス）・missingFolders（作業ディレクトリのセクションの、この機械で読んだ中に無いフォルダに置いたメモ）・ambiguousPointers（候補が 2 つ以上で、選ぶ手がかり when・discriminatedBy が無い指し先）・unresolvedPointers（判別で指す欄で選べる候補が無いもの）・lineProblems（線の種類に合わない線）・sectionProblems（セクションの種類に合わないカード）・cardProblems（種類の定義やデータの形に合わないカード）・strayFields（定義に無い欄の値）・flowProblems（flow の未完成な所・どこからも来ないノード）・peerMismatches（やり取りする flow が合わない所）・tagGroupViolations（排他のタググループの違反）、情報の組は freeCards（フリーセクションに置いたままのカード）・unreferenced（どこからも指されていない value と enum。flow のノードが運ぶもの・返すもの、行が読み書きする所は指すうちに数える）・uncheckedPatterns（pattern の読めない正規表現）・overlaps（セクションの図でほかのカードに重なっているカード）・review（線でつないだ先が、あとで直していないのに変わった UI の部品）・codeChanged（実装の線の先のコードが、覚えたあとで変わったカード）です。1 件の中身と直し方は inspection_read、設計どおりの印は inspection_update です。印を付けた件の中身が変わると（hint・moveTo のほか）、件はまた元の組に出て、acceptedBefore に前の印（reason・by・at）が付きます。
/description.text: Returns what the inspection of a tree found, one item at a time by id (branch is the tree; main if omitted). hint is what is close to a broken path. Items come in group order, and within a group as found. An item found in a done card (a goal done or cancelled, a task done) or inside one is a record, so it counts as info even in a group to fix (kind: info). counts covers the whole tree: fix, info (shown even when as designed) and accepted (marked as designed); groups gives, per group with items, kind (fix or info), label, count (items without the mark), info (of count, those counted as info; fix groups) and accepted (marked); both are before narrowing. Groups to fix: brokenPaths (paths that do not resolve), missingFolders (notes put in a folder of a working directory's section that is not in what was read on this machine), ambiguousPointers (two or more candidates and no clue, when or discriminatedBy), unresolvedPointers (discriminated pointers with no candidate), lineProblems (lines not fitting the line's kind), sectionProblems (cards not fitting the section's kind), cardProblems (cards not fitting the kind definition or data shape), strayFields (values of fields the definition lacks), flowProblems (unfinished flow parts, nodes nothing leads into), peerMismatches (partner flows that do not match), tagGroupViolations (exclusive tag groups broken). Info groups: freeCards (cards left in a free section), unreferenced (values and enums nothing points at; what flow nodes carry or return and rows read and write count as pointing), uncheckedPatterns (unreadable regular expressions in pattern), overlaps (cards overlapping others in a section's diagram), review (ui parts whose connected cards changed after the part did), codeChanged (cards whose implementation lines' code changed after it was recorded). Content and fix of one item: inspection_read; the as-designed mark: inspection_update. A marked item whose content changes (hint, moveTo...) reappears in its group with the old mark (reason, by, at) as acceptedBefore.

/description.from: 点検の件を、中身と直し方まで返します（target に inspection_list の id。配列で複数。branch に木で、省けば main）。1 件は id・group（組）・kind（fix か info。済んだカード（完了・打ち切りの goal、済みの task）とその中のカードで見つかった件は、直すものの組でも info）・label（組の見出し）・at・problem と、組ごとの中身（brokenPaths は via（書き方）・path（書いたパス）・hint（近いもの）、ambiguousPointers は candidates（候補の数）、unresolvedPointers は by（判別に使う欄）、strayFields は fields（定義に無い欄の所）、peerMismatches は peer（相手の flow）・carries（運ぶもの）、tagGroupViolations は tagGroup・count（付いているタグの数）、freeCards は section、uncheckedPatterns は regex、overlaps は section・over（重なっている相手）・moveTo（片付けるならずらす先）、review は changed（変わったカードの path・at））、fix（直し方）で、印があれば accepted（reason・by・at）、印を付けたあとで中身が変わったものは acceptedBefore（前の印）が付きます。その木で見つからない id は notFound に並びます（直ったか、ほかの木の件）。1 つも見つからなければ断ります。
/description.text: Returns inspection items with their content and how to fix them (target is an id from inspection_list; an array for several; branch is the tree, main if omitted). An item has id, group, kind (fix or info; an item found in a card that is done (a goal done or cancelled, a task done) or in a card inside one is info even in a group to fix), label (the group's heading), at, problem, and the content for each group (brokenPaths has via (how it was written), path (the path written) and hint (what is close); ambiguousPointers has candidates (the number of candidates); unresolvedPointers has by (the field used for discrimination); strayFields has fields (the places of fields the definition does not have); peerMismatches has peer (the partner's flow) and carries; tagGroupViolations has tagGroup and count (the number of tags on it); freeCards has section; uncheckedPatterns has regex; overlaps has section, over (what it overlaps) and moveTo (where to shift it to if you tidy up); review has changed (the path and at of each card that changed)), and fix (how to fix it). If it has a mark, accepted (reason, by, at) is attached, and for one whose content changed after it was marked, acceptedBefore (the previous mark). Ids not found in that tree are listed in notFound (fixed, or items of another tree). If none at all is found, it refuses.

/title.from: 点検の件に印を付ける

/description.from: 点検の件に「設計どおり」の印を付け、外します（target に inspection_list の id。配列で複数。branch は件を探す木で、省けば main）。value の accept に理由の文を渡すと印を付け（あれば書き換える）、件は直すもの・情報から外れて inspection_list の show: accepted に出ます。accept: false で印を外します（件が今の木に無くても外せる）。見つからない id・空の文・true・印の無い id への false は断り、1 つでも断れば何も書きません。印はプロジェクトに 1 つの表で、組と場所と中身が同じ件なら、どの木でも効きます（branch で付けた印は、merge したあとの main でも効く）。木の中身ではないので履歴に残らず、ロック中の main でも付け外しできます。アーカイブしたプロジェクトでは断ります。答えの updated は id ごとの印（reason・by（付けた人。MCP はアクセスキーの名前）・at。外したら null）です。
/description.text: Sets and removes the "as designed" mark on inspection items (target is an id from inspection_list; an array for several; branch is the tree to look for the item in, main if omitted). If you pass a sentence giving the reason as accept in value, the mark is set (rewritten if there is one), and the item leaves the items to fix and the info and appears under show: accepted of inspection_list. accept: false removes the mark (it can be removed even if the item is not in the current tree). An id not found, an empty sentence, true, and false for an id without a mark are refused, and if even one is refused nothing is written. The marks are one table per project, and an item with the same group, place and content is covered in any tree (a mark set in a branch also takes effect in main after the merge). They are not part of a tree's content, so they do not remain in the history, and can be set and removed even on a locked main. It refuses on an archived project. updated in the answer is the mark for each id (reason, by (who set it; for MCP, the access key's name), at; null if removed).

/description.from: セクションのアクション（op）を行います（target にセクション 1 つ）。今あるのは作業ディレクトリのセクションの read（読み込む）で、この機械で結び付けたフォルダを読み直し、中のディレクトリとファイルを今の姿にして、section_read と同じ形（folder・readType・exclude・files・directories・problem・actions）で返します。プロジェクトの中身は変えないので、読むだけのキーでも使えます。フォルダが結び付いていないときと読み方が none のときは使えません（今使えるかは section_read の actions）。ほかのセクションと、種類に無い op は、その種類のアクションを並べて断ります。
/description.text: Does a section's action (op; target is one section). There is one now, read on a working directory's section: it reads the folder bound on this machine again, brings the directories and files in it up to how they are now, and answers in the same shape as section_read (folder, readType, exclude, files, directories, problem, actions). It does not change the project's content, so a key that may only read can use it. It cannot be used when no folder is bound or the section is read as none (whether it can be used now: actions of section_read). Another section, and an op its kind does not have, are refused with the actions of its kind.
